articleTitle: Automatic Monitoring of Water Pollution based on the Combination of UAV and USV
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a water pollution monitoring system and method, and a wireless charging coil design method for a monitoring system. The unmanned boat is equipped with a platform with wireless charging function to carry the unmanned aerial vehicle to the monitoring water area, and the UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) is equipped with relevant equipment to obtain real-time SAR images of the sea surface, and then use the RBF neural network algorithm to identify and locate the oil spill area. After the power of the machine is exhausted, the UAV can be charged by the wireless charging system on the unmanned boat. The system takes full advantage of the UAV's wide viewing angle and other advantages, and uses the unmanned boat as the carrying platform to power the UAV, expands the cruise range of the UAV, can quickly and effectively supervise the relevant waters. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm for automatically identifying oil spill areas in this paper, the extracted SAR images are analyzed. The results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively identify and locate the oil spill area.

articleTitle: A High Gain Si-shaped Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a high gain Chinese character-shaped circularly polarized (CP) artistic antenna for 5G application is proposed and investigated. The Chinese character “司” with a pronunciation of “si” is developed on the top of a substrate to serve as a radiation patch, and a slightly larger metal ground plane that has a distance to the substrate is used to improve antenna gain. By modifying the position, height and parameters of the Si-shaped patch, the proposed Si-shaped Chinese character antenna can achieve excellent circular polarization characteristics. From the simulation and optimization in the HFSS 2019, the results show that the Si-shaped antenna exhibits an axial ratio bandwidth of 2.44~2.69GHz and impedance bandwidth of 2.44~2.82GHz, which can cover the n41 band of 5G communication ranging from 2.515 GHz to 2.675 GHz.

articleTitle: A Taichi-Bagua-like Metamaterial Covering High Isolation MIMO for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A Taichi-Bagua-like metamaterial (MTM) structure is realized using a single-layer substrate and covered on 2-port 5G multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna to achieve high isolation. The MTM elements in the shape of Taichi-Bagua-like structure are devised on the top layer and bottom layer of FR-4 with a 180° rotating, and they are periodically arranged to form a meta-surface and suspended above the MIMO antenna with a spacing of 3mm. The simulated results shown that the -10dB bandwidth of the proposed antenna covers 4.73-5.20 GHz with mutual coupling reduction better than 20dB in the implementation bandwidth, where the peak mutual is around -43 dB at center resonance frequency. Additionally, the radiation patterns for the devised 5G MIMO antenna with/without MTM are nearly same, providing a potential application for 5G indoor base station.

articleTitle: A 5G Hybrid Circular Polarization MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a Si-shaped circular polarization (CP) antenna for 5G communication system is proposed. The proposed antenna consists of two identical and symmetrical Chinese character “司” with two L-shaped feeding probes that are connected to the metal ground plane. The two Chinese characters “司” with a pronunciation of “Si” are modeled on the top of substrate to construct radiation elements. By simulating and optimizing in HFSS 2019, the results show that a -6 dB fractional bandwidth of 22.47% from 2.37 GHz to 2.97 GHz has been achieved for the proposed Si-shaped MIMO antenna and the axial bandwidth of 2.31~2.84 GHz, 2.30~2.87 GHz has also been obtained for each Si-shaped CP antenna element, respectively, which can cover the n41 band of 5G communication from 2.515 GHz to 2.675 GHz.

articleTitle: Development of Low Frequency Acoustics Driven Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Low frequency antennas are widely used for long-distance wireless communications including military communication, frequency modulation (FM) broadcasting and amateur radio. Herein, two types of wideband electrically small antennas for low frequency applications are briefly reviewed. To further improve the performance of the low frequency antenna, the acoustics driven very low frequency antenna is developed and its theory is introduced to discuss the development of the acoustics driven low frequency antennas.

articleTitle: Controllable Design of Filtering Attenuators Based on Graphene Integrated Dual-Mode Microstrip Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on graphene integrated dual-mode microstrip resonators, two dual-band tunable filtering attenuators with similar performance but different structures and theories are designed in this paper. The field distribution and resonance frequencies of dual-mode microstrip resonator are analyzed, so that the influence of graphene on different resonant modes can be confirmed. Then, two dynamically tunable dual-band filtering attenuators are designed. By using different design concepts and selecting appropriate loading positions of graphene, two different filtering attenuators which can achieve controllable attenuation from 1.5 dB to 7.1 dB and 1.7 dB to 7.6 dB at the first or the second band can be obtained. Last but not least, the attenuations of this two passband can be controlled independently.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation of Sar Sensor Image via Information Maximizing Generative Adversarial Net
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In practical applications, the SAR image dataset is always insufficient and lacks sample diversity. Generative adversarial nets(GANs) have been widely used to address the problem of insufficient data. However, owing to no restriction on input noise, the generated images are highly random and lack diversity. The paper proposes a data augmentation method based on the information maximizing GAN to generate samples purposefully. The proposed method is realized by using information-theoretic to extend the GAN, maximizing the mutual information between the observations and a fixed subset of noise variables. Finally, it finds out a highly semantic and meaningful hidden representation information in the SAR image and thus increases the sample diversity. The experiment results based on the MSTAD data illustrate the proposed method can effectively improve the robustness and accuracy of the classifier especially for the limited training dataset.

articleTitle: Complicated Interference Identification via Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Under complicated electromagnetic environments, useful signals often interfere with other electromagnetic systems nowadays. Then how to suppress the interferences is a critical problem. Since there is no universal suppression method for each kind of interferences, we need to identify the interferences, and then perform the specific suppression method to tackle with the interferences. In this paper, we simulate 15 types of possible interference signals, some are mixed by two different kinds of interferences, and extract seven features in the time-frequency domain under different interference-to-noise ratios (INRs). By fully analyzing these features, several common classifiers, such as random forest, gradient boosting, and a neural network, are designed to identify these complicated interferences. Numerical experiments are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. The final accuracy can exceed 95.20% at the condition INR=20dB.

articleTitle: A Wearable Textile Antenna for LoRa Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual band planar inverted-F antenna (PIFA) for wearable applications is proposed. The design utilizes the slots on the radiating plate and the ground plane to realize dual band and wire band characteristics. To verify the design, a prototype was fabricated and measured, which covers two working bands of LoRa applications, namely 433 MHz and 868 MHz. The proposed design has total radiation efficiencies above 70% across the operating bands, and a maximum gain of 1.25 dBi. The SAR of the proposed design is evaluated, which meets the European standards. The textile antenna can be a promising candidate for LoRa (Long Range) applications.

articleTitle: Radar Signal Recognition Based on Deep Residual Network with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To address the problem of poor recognition success rate (RSR) of low probability of intercept (LPI) radar signals such as polyphase codes at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), In this paper, we propose a method of deep neural network with attention mechanism for modulation recognition of radar signals. The method first transforms the received radar signal into a two-dimensional time-frequency image(TFI), and then we obtain a binary time-frequency image by threshold segmentation, and resize TFIs through bicubic interpolation. While a deep residual network with Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is designed to recognize the radar signals. We take advantage of the attention mechanism to find the effective feature information in the noise and increase the effective information weight to further improve the recognition success rate of radar signals under low SNR. Finally, the average RSR of the method is nearly 96% for 7 signals at -6dB.

articleTitle: Wide-/Dual-Band Omnidirectional Dielectric Resonator Antenna with Filtering Function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the rectangular dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is excited by a circular microstrip patch, instead of a traditional probe into the dielectric resonator. A microstrip cross with four pins located on the lower substrate is used to generate a radiation null (RN) at 3.84 GHz. A circular microstrip with four pins located on the upper substrate is used to generate a RN at 2.67 GHz. The proposed wide-/dual-band DRA are designed without the need of drilling a hole in the dielectric resonator and with the filtering function. The configuration, the simulated reflection coefficients, the realized gains and the normalized radiation characteristic of the proposed DRAs are studied and analyzed.

articleTitle: Isolation Improvement of Dual-polarized Microstrip Array Antenna by Using DGS Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-polarized single-layer microstrip array antenna with isolation improvement is proposed. Here in, the patch antenna is excited by a quarter-wavelength microstrip resonator. In order to improve the isolation between its two feeding ports, the microstrip resonator has been folded. Its simulated results show that the dual-polarized antenna array has exhibited an improved bandwidth of about -10dB ranging from 10.25 to 10.9 GHz. Meanwhile, the defected ground structure (DGS) scheme is introduced to improve its isolation from 18dB to 24dB as compared with the traditional microstrip antenna array.

articleTitle: The Impact of Obstruction by Vehicle on in-Tunnel Wireless Propagation Channel
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Tunnel environment is a critical environment that requires high safety. Particularly, obstructions by vehicles in tunnel may significantly influence the performances of wireless applications. This article presents a vehicle-to-vehicle channel measurement campaign in a tunnel environment using a wideband channel sounder. The measured frequency band is centered at 5.2 GHz with a bandwidth of 120 MHz. Both partial and full obstructions by vehicles in tunnel are considered in the measurement campaign. Based on the channel measurement data, the path loss model, K-factor and diffraction loss of different scenarios are considered and analyzed. The results show that the path loss exponent in the Non line-of-sight scenario is greater than that in the Line-of-sight and Obstructed line-of-sight scenarios. It is also found that the K-factor and the diffraction loss are dependent on the distance between transmitter and receiver. As the distance increases, the K-factor and the diffraction loss decreases.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Wireless Signal Propagation and Coverage Capability for Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the continuous maturity and application of 5G technology, the deployment and application of 5G network at sea have become an important research direction. In the marine environment, 5G wireless signal has unique propagation characteristics. This characteristic causes the poor adaptation of common channel propagation models and product parameter specifications. This paper analyzes the radio signal propagation characteristics of typical maritime communication scenarios, and compares 5G wireless signal transmission characteristics of different frequency bands. According to the characteristics and differences of NR technical solutions, an improved scheme is proposed to improve the design of base station side antenna and enhance the transmission power of terminal side. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed scheme is reasonable and feasible. The 700MHz band and 5W terminal transmitting power are selected to meet the requirements of long-distance and large bandwidth network coverage for air and sea scenes.

articleTitle: A Low Frequency Ultra-Wideband Lumped Elements Loaded Folded Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An ultra-wideband patch antenna is proposed for low frequency applications, which consists of feeder, ground layer, two folded radiating patches and several lumped elements. To increase the bandwidth of original antenna, some lumped components are integrated into the geometry of original antenna. By simulating and optimizing these lumped components, a -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 197.35% has been obtained, which is from 6 MHz to 899 MHz for the ultra-wideband patch antenna.

articleTitle: Mechanical Principle of Piezoelectric-Promoted Mechanical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the development of communication technology, the application demand of motorized low frequency antenna and chip-based high frequency antenna is increasing. The piezoelectric crystal material, commonly used in antennas, can realize the conversion between mechanical deformation and potential difference. When the excitation frequency of the input electrical signal is consistent with the natural frequency of the structure vibration response, the piezoelectric will resonate, and thus, amplify the electrical signal, which will affect the antenna frequency that is same as the nature frequency of the piezoelectric. Hence, the antenna frequency can be controlled by the deformation mode in the polarization direction of the material electrode. The simulation results can be used for the design of low frequency antenna.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation for Signal Modulation Classification using Generative Adverse Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Deep learning has been widely investigated for radio applications. The classification performance of the deep learning greatly depends on the quality of dataset. However, the deficiency of the training data is a critical issue limiting the classification accuracy in practical scenarios. In this paper, we proposed to use the generative adversarial network (GAN) as a data augmentation tool to solve the problem of inadequate training issue under the lack of sufficient data samples. The data augmentation process could be realized by Nash equilibrium of generator and discriminator. The result shows that the accuracy of the classifier is increased by nearly 4 percentage in the signal to noise ratio range of 0 to 20 dB after data augmentation.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Dual-Circularly Polarized Antenna Array Using Gap Waveguide Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band dual-circularly polarized antenna array working at Ka-band and K-band based on gap waveguide (GW) technology is proposed. The antenna is composed of a high frequency layer working at Ka-band, a low frequency layer working at K-band, and a grid layer which lowers the far field side lobe level. The power distribution network is formed by the combination of the groove gap waveguide (GGW) and the ridge gap waveguide (RGW). The energy enters the radiation cavity at the same amplitude and phase though this power distribution network. By placing inclined blocks in the cylindrical radiation cavity, the antenna radiates right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) waves at high frequency with a gain of 14.5dB and left-handed circularly polarized (LHCP) waves at low frequency with a gain of 13.8dB. The simulation results show that the antenna has a wide impedance bandwidth (27.6GHz-29.74GHz at Ka-band, 17.49GHz-21.81GHz at K-band) and a wide axial ratio (AR) bandwidth (27.5GHz-29GHz at Ka-band, 19.2GHz-20.4GHz at K-band). The proposed antenna has the characteristics of high gain, high efficiency, large power capacity, wide operating frequency band, and no need of interlayer welding.

articleTitle: Siamese Network-Based Few-Shot Learning for Classification of Human Peripheral Blood Leukocyte
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the present study, we propose a Siamese network-based few-shot learning method to classify rare human peripheral blood leukocyte images. The proposed Siamese network contains two identical convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and a logistic regression network (LRN). The CNNs are utilized to extract image features and the LRN is responsible for comparing the similarity of these features. To train the Siamese network, two leukocyte samples that belong to the same category make up genuine pairs and two leukocyte samples from disparate categories make up impostor pairs. A strategy for generating sample pairs is designed for this study to ensure the number of genuine pairs and impostor pairs is equal. After the Siamese network accomplishes the training process, with the purpose of evaluating the classification performance of the proposed Siamese network, an appropriate support set is selected to test the samples in the query. The numerical results show that the Siamese network can overcome the scarcity and imbalance of datasets used in this research, and the average classification accuracy of rare leukocyte images can achieve 89.7%, which is potential to apply the Siamese network-based few-shot learning method for addressing the issue of rare leukocyte images recognition in medicine.

articleTitle: A High-order Modulation (64-QAM) Broadband THz Communication System over 100 Gbps
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper presents the prototyping of a high-order modulation (64-QAM) terahertz (THz) communication system over 100 Gbps. To begin with, the channel capacity and spectrum efficiency of a THz link are analyzed based on Shannon’s theorem and the state of the art technology. Then, a Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC) frequency multiplier and a secondary harmonics mixer are designed and manufactured. Finally, we prototype the THz communication system and realize the transmission data rate over 100 Gbps with 64-QAM in lab. The test results in our study paves the way towards the fulfillment of the broadband and large capacity required by future sixth-generation (6G) mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Correlation Study of Two-Element CP-MIMO Array of Chinese-Character-Shaped Patch Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a correlation study into a circularly-polarized multiple-input-multiple-output (CP-MIMO) antenna array of Chinese-character-shaped patch antennas. Isolation between CP Zhong- and Guo-shaped patch antenna elements are first examined. Our results indicate that the non-identical elements exhibit linear isolation increment against the element separation. The envelope correlation coefficient is then computed using the S-parameter method, which provides a fast estimation. At 2.5 GHz, the ECC is obtained better than -30 dB at a separation of 80 mm. An average reduction rate of -2.7 dB/cm is deduced.

articleTitle: Optimal Multi-user Transmission based on a Single Intelligent Reflecting Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Intelligent Reflecting Surface (IRS) is envisioned as a revolutionary solution for providing high data rate communication, better signal coverage and physical layer security through controlling the transmission environment of electromagnetic (EM) wave. In this paper, based on a single IRS and millimeter channel model, the optimal multi-user transmission sum rate is derived with the maximal ratio combining (MRC) beamformer. The conditions to achieve such a maximum sum rate are expressed as a function of placement of transceivers, number of IRS elements and its spacing. We first transformed the single IRS assisted non-scattering mmWave channel into a high-rank multiple-in multiple-out (MIMO) channel. The result shows that even without rich scattering, each single antenna user can enjoy the maximal passive beamforming gain while keeping spatial orthogonality to leverage the maximal spatial diversity when the corresponding conditions are satisfied. Simulation results verify the existence and accuracy of optimal placement of multi-user transmission and present that the transmission sum rate of IRS channel scales by the number of IRS elements with different spacing settings.

articleTitle: A Bandwidth Enhaning 5G Soltted Antenna Operating 3.5GHz with Slitting Patches
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A multi-layer low-profile aperture-coupled antenna is proposed to get broadband and good performance, where the radiator is a slotted circular patch fed by using a microstrip line installing under its bottom via an H-shaped slot centered on ground. When the feed slot is etched below the central of the circular patch, two resonance modes are excited simultaneously. Also, the devised antenna is analyzed and optimized using characteristic mode analysis (CMA) to reveal potential patterns. The grid-slotted patch helps to obtain a very low profile of only 0.06 $\lambda_{{0}}$ ($\lambda _{{0}}$ is center wavelength in free space) as well as a wide impedance bandwidth (S11 <−10dB) of 28.6%. Moreover, the average gain at 3.5-GHz band is 9.0-dBi and efficiency foe the antenna is better than 80% with a cross-polarization <-20 dB

articleTitle: A Ground-penetrating Radar Object Detection Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) is widely applied in the detection tasks. This paper proposes a new detection method of the GPR objects, which is based on the Cascade Regional Convolutional Neural Network (Cascade R-CNN). The proposed method effectively addresses the problems caused by the existing methods with the high time cost, low detection accuracy and poor adaptability. Additionally, an adaptive clutter filter algorithm is also proposed to realize the operation of data preprocessing when constructing the data set, so as to increase the signal-to-noise ratio. The experiment results on the collected and simulation data show that the proposed method has the great performance, achieving the average precision more than 85%. It accurately detects the buried objects in different environments, demonstrating the good generalization and robustness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Cascade Regional Convolutional Neural Network (Cascade R-CNN)

articleTitle: Design of W-band Substrate Integrated Waveguide Horn Antenna for Active Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel SIW horn antenna in W-band has been proposed and demonstrated in this paper. The proposed antenna is fabricated on a single layer of silicon substrate. In order to improve the gain of the antenna, a dielectric slab using the same silicon substrate is installed at the front-end of the antenna. In order to raise the front-to-back ratio, two slots are symmetrically arranged in the top and bottom metal surface which are close to the radiating aperture. Moreover, since the width of the antenna is less than 75% wavelength and thus it is suitable for active phased array. The proposed SIW horn antenna and its 1×9 array have been investigated. A wide beam scanning range of ± 20°in H-plane covering frequency form 91.5 to 96 GHz with respect to VSWR less than 2 is achieved and a high front-to-back radio of 21.3 dB is obtained. Since our proposed W-band SIW horn antenna can be easily fabricated by existing mature CMOS processing technology, it provides a low-cost solution in millimeter-wave (mmW) active phased array application for wireless communication and radar detection.

articleTitle: Channel Emulation based on 3D End-to-End MPAC Solution
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As 5G commercialization speeding up, 5G wireless devices are in the stage of accelerated research, development and manufacturing. A major feature of 5G base station is the application of massive multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) technology, so the performance testing of 5G MIMO is a significant part ensuring the performance of 5G mobile networks. This paper introduces an end-to-end over-the-air (OTA) performance test system for 5G terminals in 3D scenarios, where uplink and downlink communication is realized via different OTA probes while guaranteeing the system reciprocity. Meanwhile by adopting phase modulation network, the system significantly saves the number of channel emulator radio frequency (RF) ports while guaranteeing the features of the entire gNodeB. Besides, a discretization probe weight calculation scheme for 3D OTA anechoic chamber is proposed to construct the 3D channel propagation environment. Simulation and test results show that the system can accurately be qualified for MIMO OTA end-to-end performance testing.

articleTitle: Wideband Microstrip Antenna Using Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband microstrip antenna using solar cells is reported for green mobile communication. Wideband performance of 55.2% has been achieved from 1.67 GHz to 2.94 GHz with a height of 0.068$\lambda_{0}$, where $\lambda_{0}$ is the wavelength of 2.3 GHz at free space. 12 solar cells are adopted for photovoltaic generation, the coverage of solar cells over the total area is more than 60%. The proposed low-profile solar cell antenna can provide a wideband performance and photovoltaic generation simultaneously.

articleTitle: Automatic Design of Uncorrelated Antennas Using Theory of Characteristic Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a simple and efficient method to design uncorrelated antennas automatically is proposed based on the theory of characteristic mode, which set no limits on the shape of the antennas. Through theoretical derivation, we relate the correlation between antennas to the feeding vectors of the antennas, and provide guidelines for designing uncorrelated antennas. Beginning with the platform of a mobile handset and the excitation of the first antenna, the feeding of the other antennas, which can provide the least correlation with the predetermined ones, can be calculated numerically, until the maximum number of the antennas is achieved. Following the procedure, a multi-antenna system is designed step by step for the mobile handset at the center frequency of 2.6 GHz.

articleTitle: A Compact Wideband Circular Polarization Antenna on the Purpose of Sub-6 GHz
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband circular polarization antenna with compact size for Sub-6 GHz is presented. The proposed antenna fed by co-planer waveguide (CPW) consists of asymmetric ground structure and modified circular-shaped radiator. Three slots are employed on the ground structure and the modified circular-shaped radiator, which is optimized to get a wide axial ratio (AR)-bandwidth. The inverted L-shaped metal-strip is designed to link with the ground, which is designed to excite two mutually orthogonal-modes with equal magnitudes to implement CP performance. By simulating and optimizing the dimensions of the antenna in the HFSS, the results show that a 43.3% (4.02-6.24 GHz) impedance bandwidth and 39.5% (3.85-5.75 GHz) CP bandwidth are achieved, respectively. Moreover, 2.58-3.8 dBi gain and stable radiating patterns are obtained within the operating frequencies.

articleTitle: Design of mm-Wave Dielectric Lens Antenna for Liquid Level Gauge Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a design of mm-wave dielectric lens antenna for liquid level gauge radar. The antenna consists of a conical horn antenna, a planar convex dielectric lens and an intermediate matching structure. The antenna is feed by a circular waveguide and simulated by FEKO. The simulation results show that the lens antenna has ideal gain and beam width, this feature can be further improved by changing the position of the feed. The millimeter-wave dielectric lens antenna designed for level gauge radar has a lens diameter of 73.1mm, a beam width of 3.7 degrees, and a gain of 31.3dBi, which can well meet the needs of mm-wave radar for narrow viewing Angle and long distance ranging.

articleTitle: A Positive and Negative HFM for Speed Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper details the wideband ambiguity function of hyperbolic frequency modulation (HFM) signal, because the ambiguity function of the HFM signal is coupled in the range dimension and speed dimension, a single HFM signal cannot eliminate the time delay caused by Doppler, which leads to ranging error. In this paper, a method of speed measurement and ranging based on positive and negative HFM combination signal is proposed, and the extensive simulation analysis of this method is carried out, which can better estimate the distance and speed of moving targets. It has reference value for engineering use application.

Author Keywords: positive and negative hyperbolic frequency modulation

articleTitle: Single-Layer Reflective Metasurface for Dual-Band OAM Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a general scheme is proposed for dual-band orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing based on a single-layer reflective geometric metasurface. As an OAM multiplexer, the proposed metasurface can distinguish different incidences featuring different incident angles, transform them into OAM waves with different topological charges (TCs) and control their reflection angle by modifying the k-space of the incidences simultaneously. In this way, the incidences can be combined into a coaxial beam without mutual interference because of the inherent orthogonality of different OAM modes. To achieve dual-band OAM multiplexing, a single-layer metal-insulator-metal (MIM) meta-atom that can independently impose arbitrary phase profiles on incidences at two different frequencies is designed. Based on it, a geometric metasurface is proposed for multiplexing OAM waves at 7 GHz and 14 GHz simultaneously. The simulated results show that eight independent data channels are created in a broadside beam when eight off-axis incidences carrying different information impinge on the proposed metasurface. This phenomenon indicates that the proposed metasurface can effectively achieve multiplexing by combining frequency and OAM domains to boost the channel capacity in wireless communications.

articleTitle: Research on LFM Combined Signal Ranging Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of PCW signal, LFM signal and positive and negative LFM signal in the application of speed measurement and ranging in engineering. The influence of target speed on LFM signal ranging is analyzed. Due to the coupling between time delay and frequency, single LFM signal cannot eliminate the Doppler time delay in ranging, which leads to ranging error. After matched filtering of the combined LFM signal based on different frequency bands and pulse widths, the ranging error can be eliminated. In this paper, a method of ranging using combined FM signal is proposed, and the simulation analysis of this method is carried out, which can better estimate the distance of moving target, and has reference value for engineering use.

articleTitle: A Novel Miniaturized Broadband Base Station Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A compact broadband dual dual-polarization antenna covering 5G bandwidth is proposed. A pair of orthogonal planar printed dipoles realize the miniaturization of the antenna by sharing dipole arms. The proposed compact antenna generates slant ±45° linear polarizations by vector synthesis. The results show that the antenna achieves a broad impedance matching of 63% (3.2-6.2 GHz) with VSWR <1.5. With the advantages of wide bandwidth, miniaturization (0.36 $\lambda_{0}\times 0.36 \lambda_{0}$, where $\lambda_{0}$ is wavelength in free space at center frequency) and stable radiation pattern, the proposed antenna would have a wide application in miniaturized base station.

articleTitle: A New Differential Dual-Polarized Filtering Microstrip Patch Antenna Without Extra Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new differential dual-polarized filtering microstrip patch antenna without extra circuit is proposed. The presented antenna is simple, symmetrical and compact, where a pair of crossed feeding line is symmetrically embedded in a circular patch. Thus, the circular patch can be divided into four identical quarter circular patches which functions as radiators as well as resonators. In addition, a very thin air layer is embedded between the substrate and the ground plane to acquire better impedance matching and higher antenna gain. For both polarization, without any extra filtering circuit, three radiation nulls (RNs) can be generated near the passband. The antenna prototype is simulated, in which great performance can be obtained. The proposed antenna features high gain, high polarization isolation, low cross-polarization level, wideband and excellent filtering performance, simultaneously. It is a good candidate for wireless communication application.

articleTitle: Identification of NLOS Condition in Different Scenarios Based on Wireless Propagation Features
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Safety driving is an essential requirement in the intelligent transportation system on expressways and urban roads. Particularly, identifying the presence of the visual connection between vehicle and vehicle, i.e., the non-line-of-sight (NLOS) identification, is important for many sensor systems on board such as optical radar, wireless positioning system and so forth. Usually NLOS identification can be done by checking the presence of the line-of-sight propagation path in wireless radio systems. In this paper, we present a study on the non-line-of-sight identification based on measurement data collected on expressways and urban intersections. Features of channel impulse response including skewness, kurtosis, root-mean-square delay spread, peak-to-average ratio and Rician-K factor are considered, and the identification accuracy of different features in different scenarios is presented. The results reveal that the skewness, kurtosis and peak-to-average ratio features are less affected by the environment, while the root-mean-square delay spread feature is obviously affected by the environment. Furthermore, it is found that the Rician-K factor is not suitable for identifying non-line-of-sight propagation in these two scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Six-cavity Ceramic Waveguide Filter with Four Transmission Zeros
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a six-cavity double CQ structure is designed by sharing the second, fifth resonant cavities and the capacitive coupling structure between the two cavities. Then diagonal coupling is introduced into CQ coupling unit, and the positions of transmission zeros are adjusted by changing the diagonal coupling amount, so as to improve the out-of-band suppression characteristics of the filter. On this basis, a six-cavity ceramic waveguide filter with four transmission zeros is designed. In the optimization process of the filter, the influence of the length change of the through slots L1 and L2 on the positions of transmission zeros is discussed in detail, and the related change rules are given. After simulation and optimization, all the performances of the filter meet the performance requirements of the 5G base station filter, which has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Oblique Aerial Photography High-resolution Environment Models for High-speed Railway Ray-Tracing Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the high-resolution three-dimensional (3D) environment model obtained by the oblique aerial photography (OAP) technique is used for ray-tracing simulations to predict radio coverage in high-speed railway scenarios. A lightweight modeling method and a customized 3D ray-tracing method are proposed to reduce the computational complexity in the simulations. A realistic high-speed railway environment model is present in this paper to evaluate the proposed methods. The results show that implementing the high-resolution environment model is capable of effectively improving the predicting accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Channel Characteristics for Congested Scene in the Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the channel characteristics of congested scene at 60 GHz in the tunnel, including empty, congested, and none line-of-sight (NLOS) tunnels. The received power and channel capacity are analyzed and compared with a first-order polynomial and an exponential distribution model proposed to describe them, respectively. Then, Doppler shift and Doppler spread in congested tunnels are analyzed. Results show that more crowded tunnels will cause greater fluctuations of azimuth angles and Doppler spread. These results will be useful for future V2V communication.

articleTitle: A Low-RCS Antenna Design with Polarization Conversion Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the two principles of phase cancellation and polarization conversion, a low-RCS antenna array loaded with polarization conversion metasurface (PCM) is proposed in this paper. To realize the reduction of RCS in the high frequency band, a 180 degree difference is generated by adopting two different units. At the same time, in the low frequency band, a corresponding RCS reduction is realized by using H-shaped patch. The simulated results indicate that not only the radiation performance of the circularly polarized antenna can be improved effectively, but also the RCS can be reduced simultaneously. And the maximum value of reduction is about 13dB.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation for Multicarrier NOMA Systems with Imperfect CSI
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: User power allocation and subcarriers assignment solution to maximize the minimum energy efficiency (EE) in a downlink transmission multi-carrier non-orthogonal multiple access (MC-NOMA) systems with imperfect channel state information (CSI) is investigated. We concentrate on EE resource allocation for a multiple user and MC system with imperfect CSI, which is a non-convex nonlinear fraction programming. We convert the problem into a convex one with the help of an auxiliary variable. For the transformed convex problem, Lagrange method is used to solve the power allocation and subcarriers assignment problem iteratively. A closed-form solution to allocate power and assign subcarriers to each user is found using the Karush–Kuhn– Tucker (KKT) conditions. Simulation illustrates that the offered scheme can substantially enhance the system EE while guaranteeing the quality of service (QoS) of total access users compared with the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Picosecond-Pulse Circuit Based on Marx Structure and SRD
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper has put forward a novel step recovery diode (SRD) circuit based on Marx structure, which analyzes the principle of Marx structure and SRD in detail. Marx structure is taken to amplify the amplitude of pulse output due to traditional SRD circuit generating low output voltage. But SRD has essential strength of picosecond transit time, applied to obtain ultra-short pulse widely. The designed circuit in this paper is composed of five stages Marx structure and SRDs in parallel adopted to sharpen rise edge and fall edge, which produces a 60 ps rise time (10%~90%), a 100 ps full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) and a 13 V output voltage.

articleTitle: D2D Communication Relay Selection Strategy Based on Two-hop Social Relationship
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Relay-assisted D2D communication can expand the communication range and improve the spectrum efficiency. However, most relay selection algorithms only consider single-hop information between transmitter and relay. To obtain better communication quality, we propose an Improved Relay Selection Strategy based on the Two-hop Social Relationship which not only considers the social relationship of transmitter-to-relay, but also the social relationship of relay-to-receiver. Besides, we combine the social awareness and channel state information to define the social relationship. The strategy determines the candidate relays according to the maximum D2D communication distance firstly, and then selects the optimal relay among candidate ones based on Two-hop Social Relationship (THSR). The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the system throughput.

articleTitle: MIMO Antenna Array Design Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar can effectively obtain a large virtual array aperture. With the development of application requirements of the MIMO radar, it is necessary to further improve the angular resolution under the certain number of antennas and the certain physical aperture. Further, the MIMO array should be designed according to practical applications. Hence in this paper, the genetic algorithm is used to design the antenna array with several constraints on the practical application requirements. These constraints include the aperture of the transmitting and receiving array, the minimum array element spacing, and the range of array element positions. The design process of a MIMO array is described in detail, and the experimental results of a MIMO array with 9 transmitter and 12 receiver is given to demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband Frequency Selective Absorber with Dual Independent Varactor-Tunable Notched Bands
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A frequency selective absorber (FSA) with two tunable notch bands is presented in this paper. The proposed FSA is composed of an ultra-wideband absorber at the top layer to achieve an absorption band from 4.4 to 18.67 GHz and two resonators at both sides of the bottom layer to realize two tunable notch bands with about 8 GHz and 4 GHz tunable range, respectively. The biasing grids are also used at the bottom layer and metal ground to adjust the voltage of the varactors, which makes notch band tunable. In order to achieve polarization insensitive, four varactors are used on one side of the bottom layer. The simulation results show that the proposed FSA has an ultrawide absorption band and two tunable notch bands.

articleTitle: Multilayer LCP Millimeter-Wave Broadband Reflectionless Bandpass Filter Based on Broside Coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This report proposes a millimeter-wave broadband reflectionless bandpass filter which is integrated by a bandpass filter and a bandstop filter. The bandpass filter is constructed by cascaded coupling lines, and the bandstop filter is constructed by a coupling line and a stub line. By adopting the hybrid broadside coupling structure of a coplanar waveguide and a microstrip, the broadband characteristics of the filter can be realized. At the same time, broadband reflection wave absorption is introduced in the auxiliary channel by two cascaded bandstop filters. The reflectionless bandpass filter centers at 47GHz with a fractional bandwidth of 62%, insertion loss of 1.04dB, and out-of-band suppression of more than 17dB. The return loss of the reflectionless bandpass filter is better than 10dB from 22.88GHZ to 68.52GHz, meanwhile, high frequency selectivity is also realized.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarized Zhe-Shaped Conformal Patch Antenna for 5G Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We propose a dual-polarized conformal Zhe-shaped patch antenna that is suitable for future millimeter wave (mmW) applications. The proposed antenna is composed of 3 different layers. A Zhe-shaped (喆) patch is printed on the upper surface of the top dielectric layer. In order to excite the Zhe-shaped radiating patch, two feeding networks are designed in the other two layers. The simulation result shows that a frequency bandwidth of 10.5% (24.75-27.5 GHz) and a good isolation performance (< -26 dB) in the working frequency band can be achieved.

articleTitle: Near-field Over-the-Air Calibration of Phased Array Using Plane Wave Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a near-field phased array calibration method using the plane wave generator. By predesigning the phase setting matrix, we calculate the true excitations of each array channel by solving the linear equations of signal with the pre-measured scattering parameters between the probe and the antenna under test. A taper function excitation method is used in the synthesis of plane wave generator. The method has similar computational complexity to the far-field single fixed probe method and same performance in determining the inhomogeneities among different array channels. Numerical simulations confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: High-Power Rectifier Antenna Array in X Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high-power and miniaturization of rectifier antenna array, the paper presents an X-Band high-power rectifier antenna array which is composed of rectifier circuit and receiving antenna array with power division network. The rectifier circuit can convert 2W of RF energy into 0.929W of DC energy. We use MATLAB to simulate the energy distribution on the surface of the rectifying antenna array when 2000W radio frequency energy is emitted from 100 meters away and calculate the output DC power of the rectifier circuit as 199.03W.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of CNN Traffic Lights Classification Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) has acquired remarkable achievements in image classification and target detection. It is of great significance to the field of unmanned driving. As a professional accelerating device that is good at parallel computing, FPGA can fully exploit the parallel processing capacity of CNN. Deploying CNN on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) has a wide range of applications. This paper proposes a tri-classification convolutional neural networks with a simple structure and easy FPGA implementation, which is used to realize traffic lights recognition. Based on the understanding of the convolution process, this design adopts methods such as optimized array structure, multi-level data multiplexing, and positive index classification to improve parallelism in the hardware implementation process, which can take into account speed and performance. Transplant the improved CNN to FPGA through High-level Synthesis (HLS) software. The experimental results present that the accuracy of traffic lights classification can reach about 99%, and the processing speed on the FPGA platform is 22 times higher than that on Inter Core i5-8300H CPU.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Balanced Feed Low Cross-Polarization Quad-Ridged Horn Antenna for OTA Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the analysis of a balanced feed low cross-polarization quad-ridged horn antenna. The S-parameters of the equivalent circuit is proposed which help the quad ridged transmission line design. The electric field amplitude of the fusiform-shaped cross filler conductor is further analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the fusiform-shaped cross filler in reducing the level of cross-polarization. The comparison of the electric field distribution of the quad-ridge waveguide loaded with fusiform-shaped cross filler conductor and the modes supported by the traditional quad-ridge waveguide is also shown to explained the principle of reducing cross polarization.

articleTitle: A Wideband Quasi-Yagi Antenna Using Four-Step Slotline with Metasurface for Sub-6G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband quasi-Yagi antenna using four-step slotline with metasurface for sub-6G applications is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna is composed of a novel quasi-Yagi antenna using four-step slotline with a metasurface on the front side, and an integrated balun at the bottom on the back side. The four-step slotline along the center of the antenna is used to improve the impedance matching and the metasurface is used to enhance the gain. Simulation results show that the proposed antenna has a wide bandwidth of 2.99-5.83GHz(64.4%) and a stable gain of 5.74-7.75dBi. To verify the validity of the proposed approach, a prototype of the proposed antenna was fabricated and measured. The proposed antenna can find its use in sub-6G applications as a wideband high-gain base station antenna.

articleTitle: A ±45° Dual-Polarized Flat-Topped Radiation Antenna Array for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: $A \pm 45^{\circ}$ dual-polarized planar antenna array with flat-topped radiation pattern is proposed. A bandwidth of 36.6% (2.9-4.2 GHz) with port isolation larger than 30 dB is achieved by using a pair of orthogonal T-shaped feeding lines to excite a pair of modified square-ring shaped dipoles. An array including $3 \times 3$ radiating elements has been designed and analyzed. By modifying the amplitude and the phase of each antenna element, a flat-topped radiation pattern that is suitable for the 5G applications is yielded.

articleTitle: Wideband Millimeter-wave OFDM Uplink with Hybrid Receiving
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we study millimeter-wave orthogonal frequency division multiplexing uplink transmission with a wide bandwidth and hybrid receiving. By considering the spatial- and frequency-wideband effects in the channel model, the spectral efficiency of the system is analyzed. The analysis and the simulation results show the beam squint effect caused by the wideband effects. Moreover, the impacts of the bandwidth and the number of subcarriers on the beam squint effect are revealed.

articleTitle: Tunning the Q-Factor in a Reverberation Chamber Mechanically
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: For a reverberation chamber (RC), the chamber quality factor (Q-factor) is a useful parameter which can be used to control the coherence bandwidth in over-the-air (OTA) testing. To obtain the expected Q-factor, we install a controllable metal curtain on a wall and absorbing materials are placed behind the curtain. By adjusting the exposed area of the absorbing materials, the RC Q-factor can be controlled. We also test the field uniformity (FU), correlated angles in different scenarios. The measurement results show that with the change of the curtain area, the Q-factor and the correlated angles can be tuned. The effects on the field uniformity are investigated.

articleTitle: A 68% PAE, 800-W, L-Band Internally Matched GaN Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an 800W, L-Band internally matched power amplifier has been developed. Taiwan win $0.45\mu \mathrm{m}$ gallium nitride (GaN) high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) technology is used and the total gate width of the chip is 115.2mm. The internally matched amplifier has demonstrated the output power of over 800W, power density of 10W/mm and the power gain of 15dB across 1.2GHz to 1.4GHz with the voltage of 50V, the power added efficiency is between 59% and 68% under the pulse condition at a duty of 10% with a pulse of width of $100\mu \mathrm{s}$.

articleTitle: Measuring the Total Radiated Energy of Transient Signals in a Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: For a continuous wave (CW) signal, the total radiated power (TRP) can be measured in a reverberation chamber (RC). In this paper, we show that the total radiated energy (TRE) can also be measured in an RC for transient signals, and observe that the proposed method has fast convergence speed for wideband signals. Measurements are performed to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improvement and Implementation of Genetic Algorithm for Location Scheme in Location-Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Location-Routing Problem is a logistics transportation optimization problem, which includes two coupling sub problems of “location scheme” and “path planning”. The optimal path is determined by the location scheme, therefore, it is important to choose appropriate methods to solve the location problem. Location problem is a kind of resource allocation problem, so, on the basis of giving full play to the advantages of genetic algorithm in solving “allocation problem”, the improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the location problem through a series of improvement strategies such as the subsection coding strategy based on classification rules of transportation nodes, population initialization based on Halton sequence, multi-point sequential crossover strategy, and the mutation strategy based on gene-sequence. Finally, the case study demonstrates the feasible and superiority of the proposed methodologies.

articleTitle: Information Value Measurement Distribution Model Based On Improved Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: in order to meet the needs of modern war for high-quality situation information, this paper first proposes a battlefield situation information value measurement model based on improved information entropy from the perspective of battlefield situation information. According to the situation information index system, the degree of information demand satisfaction, and the principle of minimum error, the information entropy is improved to realize the battlefield situation information value measurement. Then, referring to Link16’s distributed route selection algorithm based on R2 reporting responsibility, a message distribution algorithm based on information value is designed to give priority to the transmission of high-value information flow in the network. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by the simulation of typical combat scenarios of close air support, especially in the case of strong confrontation environment.

articleTitle: Ship Motion Attitude Prediction Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition and Gaussian Process Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Under the influence of wind, waves and ocean current, ships sailing at sea will produce random and complex motions. Accurate ship motion attitude prediction offers improvements in safety and efficiency for marine operations. In this paper, a new hybrid prediction model of ship motion attitude is proposed based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and Gaussian process regression (GPR), called EMD-GPR model. The EMD-GPR model and the GPR model were implemented using measured rolling angle data and pitch angle data from a real ship sailing at sea. The results show that EMD processing method can effectively suppress the nonlinearity and non-stationarity of ship attitude, and the hybrid EMD-GPR model is better than the GPR model.

articleTitle: Research on Radiated Interference of Motor Driven Converter of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the difficulty of predicting electromagnetic radiation interference in electric vehicles and the long simulation time, this paper proposes a field-circuit coupling simulation method. First, the software simulation of the road is used to extract the radiation interference source of the drive converter, and then the cavity of the electric vehicle is established. The simulation model of the body uses the FDTD method to solve the spatial electromagnetic field distribution. Compared with commercial software, the simulation results of this method are effective, and the simulation speed is fast, and the simulation results of the frequency band can be obtained.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Control Based on Discrete Model of Dual Active Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Dual active bridge (DAB) converters are widely used in power electronic systems and energy storage devices. However, due to the existence of semiconductor power switches, the converter is a typical strongly nonlinear, variable structure, discrete circuit system in essence. Some strange behaviors often occur when it works, such as some unknown electromagnetic noise, intermittent instability and sudden collapse of the system. In this paper, the nonlinear behavior of dual active bridge converter is studied. Firstly, based on the existing method of constructing discrete model, the discrete iterative model of DAB converter considering the sample and digital control delay is established. The relationship between the stability of the DAB converter and the parameters of the proportional controller is analyzed through the simulation comparison between the discrete iterative model and the traditional single phase shift control model. Finally, the stability boundary is accurately predicted by the phase trajectory diagram, and the bifurcation phenomenon is successfully suppressed by the parametric resonance perturbation method.

articleTitle: A VLF Resonant Antenna Based on Piezoelectric Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A very low frequency (VLF) resonant antenna based on piezoelectric ceramics is proposed in this paper. Combined with Maxwell's equations, electrostatic equations and piezoelectric constitutive equations, COMSOL Multiphysics is used to coupling structural mechanics, electrostatics and electromagnetic waves. A disk resonant antenna with a radius of 50mm, a thickness of 6mm and an operating frequency of 90.5 kHz is designed using piezoelectric ceramics (PZT-5H) as the material. The simulation results show that the radiation characteristics of the antenna become stronger with the increase of the boundary load applied on the upper surface of the piezoelectric disk. The number of parallel antennas will also enhance its radiation characteristics and achieve the matching between the antenna and the feed. In addition, the disk resonant antenna can be equivalent to a dipole antenna [4]. Compared with the electrically small antenna of the same size, it can achieve high efficiency and miniaturization without loading complex matching circuit.

articleTitle: High Gain Wideband Planar Aperture Antenna Array for 5G Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel high gain planar aperture antenna array, which is applied to 5G millimeter-wave systems, is proposed in this paper. The antenna element is fed by a slot on a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW). The element radiation structure consists of an opening cavity with multiple cross-shaped patches on the top, which extend the aperture field to realize an uniform aperture electric field distribution and thus a high element gain. Simulated results show that its operation band is from 26.2 to 29.6 GHz (12.2%), covering the n257 band (26.5-29.5GHz) with a peak gain of 19.65dBi. Based on the element, a 4 × 2-element antenna array is designed, whose -10-dB impedance bandwidth covers from 25.9 to 29.6 GHz (13.3%). The gain reaches about 24.5-26.7dBi within the operating band. The proposed array is suitable for packaging integration and can be potentially used for 5G point-to-point communication applications.

articleTitle: A Video SAR Imaging Algorithm for Micro Millimeter-Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of small-size, low cost and high resolution, the millimeter-wave synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has the unique property during the high-resolution imagery of the observations. In this article, a millimeter-wave video synthetic aperture radar (ViSAR) imaging algorithm is proposed based on the micro platforms, which can constantly produce SAR images at a high frame rate and dynamically monitor a region of interest. In the scheme, an overlapped sub-aperture strategy is applied to segment data, and two-dimensional (2D) de-chirp processing is applied to each segmented data for high resolution imaging. Finally, the Chirp-Z transform (CZT) is utilized to resolve the distortion problem of SAR image. Experiments based on simulated and measured data verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Study of CVD Graphene on Synthesis Parameters and Sheet Resistance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a systematic study on the growth process of CVD graphene was conducted. Then the optimized growth parameters of CVD graphene were obtained through orthogonal experiment. And the direct corresponding relationship between growth parameters and the sheet resistance of graphene band was given by parametric comparison experiment and formula fitting. The result in this paper established a bridge between basic research and application of graphene in microwave band.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Voltage Controlled Oscillator with Suspended Stripline Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Voltage controlled oscillator (VCO) is the core basic device of RF and microwave circuit. Its performance determines the performance of the whole system. Microstrip planar oscillators are more and more popular in communication systems because of low cost, small size and easy integration. However, the low Q value of microstrip planar oscillators makes it difficult to achieve low phase noise. The suspended stripline is a kind of planar and closed structure, which has the advantages of low transmission loss, high Q value and simple structure. It is compatible with the current circuit board and easy to process. In this paper, a 2.9GHz~5.4GHz VCO is designed with a suspended stripline structure.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Time-Modulated Rotationally Symmetric Circular Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Time-modulated rotationally symmetric circular array (TMRSCA) is designed and synthesized in this paper. All the elements are distributed over the Q annular sectors and controlled by Q high speed RF switches, respectively. The element number in each annular sector, the specific time sequences, and the element positions are optimized by the improved harmony search (ImHS) algorithm for the sidelobe level (SLL) suppression at the operating frequency. An example is presented and the numerical results are compared with several previously published solutions, which illustrated the potential advantages of TMRSCA in time-modulated circular planar array design.

articleTitle: Radio Spectrum Scarcity for Maritime Communication and Navigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of the used radio spectrum for maritime communication and navigation systems. The scarcity of radio spectrum worldwide triggers the joint development of communication and navigation systems and requires propagation models for the joint used spectrum. Current developments on vehicular systems lead to a common use of radar and communication spectrum. The opportunities to utilize jointly a common spectrum are mostly driven by the need of additional communication capacity. However, common maritime communication spectrum is scarce. By jointly utilizing the same spectrum new opportunities could be developed for the mutual benefit of all systems. Therefore, we ask regulatory and scientific bodies to consider mutual systems.

articleTitle: The Mode Splitting of Spoof Localized Surface Plasmons Hybridization Used for Liquid Characteristic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A high-sensitivity planar microfluidic sensor based on coupled spoof localized surface plasmons (SLSPs) is proposed in this paper. By stacking two SLSP disks with same dimensions on the top and bottom layers to form a strong interaction and to produce mode splitting, a notch point is formed on the basis of the dipole resonant modes (ω- and ω+). The notch point can be converted into a shift of the resonant frequency, and thus the influence of the dielectric loss of the sample on the performance of the highly sensitive structure is reduced. Compared to other conventional microwave microfluidic sensors made of planar resonators, the sensitivity of the proposed sensor is greatly improved. The water-ethanol binary mixture is used for verification in the experiment.

articleTitle: Path Loss Modeling and Analysis for Low Antenna Height over Grass Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Wave propagation modeling over grass terrains with low antenna height is essential for applications such as wireless sensor deployment and vehicular communication in rural environment. In this paper, a theoretical multi-ray path loss model is proposed for low antenna height over grass environment, which incorporates the direct, reflected, and diffracted rays. A set of measurements is performed to verify the proposed model. The developed model is also validated with already published measurements data from the literature, and found to have better predicting accuracy as compared to the existing path loss models. The proposed path loss model can be used to support the design of the wireless sensor and vehicular networks over grass environment.

articleTitle: Variable Variance Kalman Filter for Line of Sight Angle Jump Suppression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The LOS (line of sight) angle will jump twice before and after the infrared imaging guided missile identify the infrared decoy, which will cause the mutation of guidance command and reduce the guidance accuracy. The LOS angle jump model is established based on point source decoy, and the mechanism of LOS angle jump is derived. To solve the problem of miss distance increase caused by LOS angle jump, on the basis of traditional Kalman filter method which takes the current statistical model as the LOS motion form, a Kalman filter with variable variance is designed to extract LOS angular velocity. The simulation results show that under the influence of decoys, the accuracy of LOS angle and angular velocity output by traditional Kalman filtering method is poor, while the Kalman filtering method with variable variance can greatly improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: Large-angle Beam-scanning Phased Array Designs Based on the Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the metasurface, a large-angle beam-scanning phased array design is introduced in this paper. Due to the mutual coupling changes significantly with the increase of the scanning angle, the scanning coverage is generally limited. The metasurface design is an effective method to overcome this problem. Generally, the metasurface is designed as an impedance matching layer and placed in parallel at some distance above the array. Here, a metasurface composed of periodically arranged subwavelength cross-shaped metals is designed. The designed metasurface is used as the decoupling wall to broaden the scanning coverage.

articleTitle: Left-Hand Circularly Polarized Phased Array with High Gain for Mobile Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper discussed the design of 32 × 32 left-hand circularly polarized (LHCP) phased array antenna at Ku-band for satellite communications. In this paper, planar phased array antenna principle, single radiating element structure and analysis and simulation of antenna array are presented. The array is compact and the whole front-end of this array can be placed on the same multilayer printed circuit board (PCB). Thus, this array is easy to be carried by satellites. With 33.43dB maximum gain, good axial radio performance and scanning range from 0 to 60, the array provides superb performance for satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: A Polarization Conversion Metasurface for Characterization of Dielectric Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A microwave sensor based on polarization conversion meta-surface is proposed in K-band. The permittivity of materials is characterized by the frequency shift of the axial ratio, ellipse angle and polarization angle curve of the transmitted wave when a linear incident wave passes through the polarization conversion meta-surface. Compared to the traditional sensors that detect the material parameters based on the results of amplitude and phase of the transmission, the proposed sensor shows a robust performance which is less affected by the environment.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave Bandpass Filter Based on Self-packaged LCP Multi-layer Suspended Coplanar Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this report, a millimeter wave bandpass filter with simple SIR structure based on LCP multi-layer suspended coplanar waveguide is proposed. The circuit is self-packaging and has good electromagnetic shielding. The proposed bandpass filter is designed centering at 33.9GHz with a 3dB fractional bandwidth of 4%, an insertion loss of 2.1dB, and a return loss of greater than 18dB. Transmission zeros on both sides of the passband have been implemented, which introduces high frequency selectivity and good out-of-band suppression, while ultra wide stopband of more than 20GHz is also achieved.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Network for Radar-Based Human Activities Classification with Low Training Data Support
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Deep learning has shown tremendous prospects in human activity recognition based on micro-Doppler radar. However, the deficiency of radar data because of the extremely high labor and costs involved in obtaining radar data has hindered deep learning-based radar applications. In this paper, we proposed to use the discriminator of the generative adversarial network(GAN) for the radar-based human activities classification with low training data support. In supervised adversarial training, the generated samples and real samples are both sent to the discriminator for joint training, and thus the performance of the discriminator is boosted by both the real samples and generated samples. When the training samples are limited, GAN might fail to converge. In this paper, we firstly proposed a novel parameters initialization method of GAN to speed its convergence. The trained discriminator is fine-tuned on the training set for a few epochs. The classification results indicate that our proposed model can improve the classification accuracy and outperform the state-of-art models, especially when the training samples are limited.

articleTitle: Improved Mapping Optimization Algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Networks (IMOAG)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To solve the NP-difficult problem of Network-on-Chip (NoC) mapping, researchers currently use heuristic search algorithms represented by Genetic Algorithm (GA) for optimization. However, as the scale of the problem increases, the performance of these algorithms will deteriorate rapidly, and the global optimal solution cannot be obtained. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved mapping optimization algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), which combines GA with GANs to overcome the former's shortcomings.
