The simulation results show that compared to GA without GANs post-processing, in MMSE-IRC and SVD examples of the wireless communication system, the optimal solution obtained by trained GANs is closer to the true optimal solution, and their power consumption is reduced by 24.49% and 17.54% respectively, while the delay is reduced by 10.89% and 8.77% respectively, and it performs better in terms of distribution and convergence.

articleTitle: A Wide-Beamwidth Differentially-Fed Filter Antenna for Ultra-wideband Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wide-beamwidth differentially-fed filter antenna for ultra-wideband (UWB) communications is presented. The proposed antenna includes two parts: a radiating structure in the upper substrate and a differential feeding structure in the lower one. The antenna profile is 0.06$\lambda_{0}$ (where $\lambda_{0}$ is the initial wavelength). Simulation results verify that the antenna has a bandwidth of 6.36-8.57 GHz and its gain is 5.1 ± 1.2 dBi.

articleTitle: Simulation on the TRL Calibration of a MEMS Filter using MEMS Micro-coaxial Probe
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an on-wafer S-parameter calibration method and a complete set of TRL calibration kits are presented. Both the calibration kits as well as the micro coaxial probes are designed based on a MEMS process. An eight-term error model is used to do the calibration and the calibration process is performed using the EM full wave simulation software. Moreover, we design these calibration kits and the micro-coaxial probes in order to verify some experimental results from our previous work, that the crossover effect between the probes as well as the surface wave degraded the measured rejection of a W band MEMS filter. As a result, the simulation results fit the measured result well, demonstrating the validity of the probes and the kits design, future work can be delegated to the design of more sophisticated calibration kits and algorithms to alleviate the aforementioned problems.

articleTitle: A Novel Optimal Subarray Partition Method for Large Uniform Linear Array based on Hierarchical Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In large-sized uniform linear array (ULA) antennas, in order to reduce the complexity and application cost, it is necessary to use subarray partition technology to optimally divide the antenna array. A novel optimal subarray partition method for large ULA antennas based on the Hierarchical clustering algorithm is proposed in this paper. This method combines fast Fourier transform (FFT) and Hierarchical clustering algorithm to optimize the antenna array with low sidelobe. In this way, the beampattern of array antenna has low sidelobe while the mainlobe points to the desired direction. The large ULA antennas can be divided into subarrays successfully. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A Wideband Linear-to-Circular Polarizer based on Hexagonal FSS on PDMS Substrate for CubeSats
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel flexible single-layered and single-sided linear to-circular polarizer is proposed in this work. The proposed polarizer is designed for a deployable format for application in a 3U Cube Satellites. It features a near-zero 3 dBAR, with a size of 0.22 $\lambda_{0}\times 0.27\lambda_{0}\times 0.03\lambda_{0}$ and a 3dB AR fractional bandwidth of 34.39 %, starting from 1.95 GHz to 2.76 GHz. It performs with a conversion efficiency bandwidth covering 90% of 43.47 %, starting from 1.8 GHz to 2.8 GHz. This indicates the polarizer’s wideband CP performance, with a pure CP centered at 2.41 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of Tri-band Unidirectional Printed Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a tri-band unidirectional printed antenna is presented. By employing a torch-shaped structure to cooperate with a pair of side-by-side rectangular patches, triple band characteristics are realized. Simulation results show that the working frequency bands are 806-960 MHz, 1.71-2.7 GHz and 3.3-3.7 GHz, respectively, which cover the LTE700/ GSM850/ GSM900, S-band and WLAN frequency bands. A compact and simple structure with good radiation characteristics is achieved by the proposed antenna, which is suitable for multi-frequency wireless communications.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm Based on Two-step CN-FDTD
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: When studying the crosstalk of long-distance owerhead transmission lines, Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) method is limited by Courant Friedrichs Lewy (CFL) stability conditions. The improved method breaks through the limitation of CFL, but the accuracy can be reduced. This paper proposes a new high-precision method that breaks through the unconditional stability. By solving the transmission line equation, the electromagnetic field changes caused by the field-line crosstalk of the transmission line are directly solved. Combining the Crank-Nicolson (CN) difference method and the two step FDTD method, the two step Crank-Nicolson Finite Difference Time Domain algorithm (two-step CN-FDTD) is proposed. This algorithm is of great significance to the study of long-distance transmission line crosstalk because of its good adaptability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband and Large Incident Angle Transparent Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In response to the current low detectability requirements for optical windows, this paper proposes an optically transparent absorber based on indium tin oxide (ITO) and metal grid structure, which is composed of PET, copper grid, PMMA and cross-ring ITO. The total thickness is 3.85mm. The simulation results show that the absorption rate can reach more than 90% in the range of 6.3-19.3GHz, the relative absorption bandwidth is 102%. The good absorption properties can be maintained within the incidence range of 60 degrees. Meanwhile, high visible light transmission rate is achieded. Based on the high transparency and good absorption, the optically transparent absorber has broad application prospects on many experimental platforms.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized Microstrip Antenna for Smart Home Wireless Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Three Miniaturized Microstrip antennas are proposed in this paper. In the first miniaturized antenna, the CSRR (Complementary Split Ring Resonator) is etched on the metal ground plate as the DGS (Defected Ground Structure), which reduces the area by 30.78% compared with the traditional rectangular antenna. The second antenna uses meander technology, and introduces non-radiation edge notches and two groups of slots on the radiation patch, which reduces the area by 34.11% compared with the traditional rectangular antenna. The third antenna combines DGS and meander technology, which reduces the area by 47.51% compared with rectangular antenna, and has better miniaturization effect. The antenna has a good resonant mode meeting the requirements of Wi-Fi band (2.40-2.4835 GHz) commonly used in smart home, and has a promising application prospect in the design of smart home wireless sensor nodes.

articleTitle: I/Q Imbalance Joint Calibration of Transmitter and Receiver with Zero-IF Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Compared with the superheterodyne receiver, the zero-IF transceiver has the advantages of low complexity, high integration and low cost, but the zero-IF transceiver has the problem of amplitude and phase imbalance between I/Q channels. In this paper, I/Q imbalance calibration scheme for zero-IF architecture is proposed. The I/Q imbalance model is established, and the principle of sideband suppression is derived. Based on the I/Q imbalance calibration scheme of narrowband signal, this paper introduces the calibration scheme of wideband signal, and innovatively proposes an I/Q imbalance joint calibration scheme of transmitter and receiver. The joint calibration scheme can be implemented without external instruments and has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Ring Slot-based Antenna Design for mmWave Intergrted OAM Wave Excitations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a ring slot antenna modified by the substrate integrated resonator is proposed for OAM wave excitation at mmWave band. The strip line is employed as a power divider to generate four feeding points with π / 2 phase delays. Changing the ring design parameters can help to adjust the surface current distribution, and further excite the OAM waves with different modes. This antenna topology has the advantages of a low profile, easy for integration and tuning of radiation modes, as well as a maximal radiation gain of 8.5 dBi at 26.0 GHz.

articleTitle: A Compact Dual-Band Patch Antenna Based on SISL for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-band patch antenna using substrate integrated suspended line (SISL) technology is presented in this paper. The presented antenna has a small size of 0.6$\lambda_{\mathbf{0}}* 0.62\lambda _{\mathbf{0}}(\lambda_{\mathbf{0}}$, the wavelength in free space of the lower operating frequency). The antenna consists of four parts: a feeding line, a metal strip, a driven patch, and a stacked patch. Specifically, the driven patch is excited by the feeding line to generate the lower frequency resonance mode and the upper one is created by the stacked patch. The bandwidth is 3.18-3.63 GHz and 4.78-5.04 GHz which is significantly improved by adding a metal strip. For the lower and upper band, the maximum gain is 7.6 dBi and 8.6 dBi based on the all FR4 substrates. Besides, the radiation efficiency is higher than 92% within the passband.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Surrogate Based Optimization with Feature Assistance for Microwave Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Surrogate based optimization techniques are widely used for electromagnetic design optimization of microwave filters. This paper review the recent advanced works in surrogate optimization using feature parameter. Feature frequency and feature height are further utilized to speedup optimization process. A microwave filter example is applied to illustrate this advanced techniques.

articleTitle: Wideband Dual-Polarized Vortex Beams Reflectarray Antenna with Independently Controllable Dual Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband dual-polarized reflectarray is proposed to generate dual-mode vortex beams carrying orbital angular momentum in this paper. The reflectarray unit is composed of a pair of orthogonal tightly coupled dipoles and delay lines, which can provide independent control of the x-polarized and y-polarized incidence by varying the length of delay lines. The dual-mode vortex beam is achieved by independently manipulating the orthogonally linearly polarized incident waves. To verify the design concept, a wideband dual-polarized dual-mode vortex beams reflectarray operating at 5-8GHz is designed. The simulated results show that the dual-polarized vortex beams carrying +2 and -2 mode of orbital angular momentum are successfully generated from 5-8GHz. The orbital angular momentum mode bandwidth in this design is wider than other similar reports.

articleTitle: Channel Spatial Profile Validation for FR2 New Radio Over-the-air Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Over-the-air (OTA) radiated testing of 5G new radio (NR) at frequency range 2 (FR2) is seen mandatory due to integrated radio frequency circuits and antenna design. Multiprobeanechoic chamber (MPAC) solution is the reference method for performance testing of FR2 NR in the standardization. One of the key topics for the MPAC solution is channel validation. The test zone size in wavelength is much larger for FR2 MPAC setups. Furthermore, the far-field assumption will be violated due to the compact MPAC system. Those new aspects have introduced new challenges for the channel spatial profile validation in the test zone. In this work, a generic channel spatial profile validation method is numerically analyzed, with a focus on the the impact of test zone radius, measurement distance error and spatial location selection in the test zone on the channel spatial profile validation results.

articleTitle: Joint Placement and Power Allocation Optimization for Sum Rate Maximization in NOMA-based UAV Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) network based on non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) jointly optimizes the location and power allocation (PA) of UAV to achieve better sum rate. However, this non-convex sum rate maximization problem is difficult to solve. Therefore, we decompose this non-convex problem into two sub-problems. First, genetic algorithm (GA) is used to solve the position optimization problem, which is equivalent to sum rate maximization problem. Then, the closed-form PA algorithm is used to further maximize the sum rate under a fixed UAV’s location obtained by GA. Compared with PA algorithm with geometric center placement, numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation for UAV-based Distributed Jamming System: An Illustrative Example
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Distributed operations have become a promising concept in the future of information and intelligent warfare. Conventional single multi-functional jammer has limited coverage due to the beamwidth. In order to further improve the jamming performance, this paper analyzed the UAV-based distributive jamming model, and simulated the radar detection performance under single line formation and arch formation. The jamming effect is evaluated with an effective assessment indicator. Experimental results show the superiority of the arch formation, manifesting more jamming power can enter from the main lobe of the receiver antenna, in which detection gaps are effectively eliminated.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-range False Target Jamming Technique based on Quasi KLT Basis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Interrupted sampling pulse repeating jamming is a new type of range deception jamming, which can produce deceptive and suppressive jamming effects on chirp radars. In addition, the jammer has the ability to instantaneously forward such jamming, so that the traditional waveform diversity technology cannot achieve the suppression of such range deception jamming. Therefore, this paper proposes a dictionary learning method based on the quasi-KLT base, which can realize the separation of the target and the jamming signal, and finally achieve the purpose of suppressing the jamming. The results of simulation experiments show that the proposed method can effectively combat the interrupted sampling and repeating range false target jamming.

articleTitle: Smart Vest Design for Vessel Based on Artificial Magnetic Conductors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low observability electromagnetic protective clothing design method based on artificial magnetic conductor(AMC) structure is proposed. The basic principle of reducing the reflected energy of electromagnetic wave with AMC structure and the typical structure design workflow are introduced. Taking a small vessel model as an example, the maximum radar cross-sectional area corresponding to the typical incident direction before and after the installation is compared and analyzed through simulation calculation, and the effectiveness of the proposed design method in reducing the radar cross-sectional area of the vessel is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Cable EM interference Based on Multi-conductor Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi-conductor transmission lines can be used in electromagnetic compatible simulation which has good agreement with the test results. In this paper, a model of three transmission lines is established which described the electromagnetic interference of typical high-power equipment to sensitive equipment. Test platform is also established and the simulation results are basically consistent with the test results which verified the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Measurement of Five-port Power Divider Based on Three-port Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the actual four-way power dividing chip can accommodate up to three ports for on-chip testing at the same time, this paper presents a testing and data processing method for the power divider chip by using three ports of a four-port vector network analyzer (VNA). A four-way power divider circuit is designed in the simulation tool and connected to non-ideal loads to obtain five sets of three-port S-parameter, then they are merged into a five-port S-parameter. Comparing the combined five-port S-parameter with the simulated five-port S-parameter with ideal loads, it is found that the combined four-channel signals’ insertion loss amplitude error is less than 0.2 dB, and the phase error is less than 0.6°, and the combined S-parameter can correctly characterize the amplitude and phase characteristics of the insertion loss of the splitter branch. Because of the load mismatch, the return loss error of the five ports will be relatively larger. Then a VNA is used to test the four-way splitter on-chip, and the obtained three-port S-parameters are combined into a S5P model. Compared with the splitter’s datasheet, the obtained data can correspond to the simulation experiment results.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of Patch Antenna with Double Torsion Coil Feeding Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dielectric substrate with high relative permittivity is used to miniaturize the patch antennas with double torsion coil feeding structure. The double torsion coil feeding structure is used to achieve wide bandwidth. The size of the linearly polarized patch antenna and the dual-polarized patch antenna is decreased by 50% and 61%, respectively, while maintaining good radiation and polarization characteristics. Furthermore, the decoupling ground is applied to a $1\times 2$ linearly polarized array. The isolation can be better than 25 dB with improved radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Frequency-Selective Absorber with Ultra-Wide Absorption Band And Adjustable Notch Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a frequency-selective absorber (FSA) with ultra-wide absorption band and adjustable notch band. The top layer of the structure is a lossy layer, which uses a traditional ring structure with lumped resistors inserted in the four sides and round metal patches on the four corners. A notch resonator is placed on the top of bottom substrate as the lossless layer instead of the metal plane used in traditional absorber. The structure of this paper realizes the adjustment of the notch band by modifying the value of the capacitors in the lossless layer without reducing the absorption performance. The proposed FSA has a simple structure and an ultra-wide absorption band of 5-22 GHz, which has good stealth performance and application prospects.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Provincial Tourist Population based on Grey Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the data set of the number of tourists in Shandong Province from 1990 to 2019 is obtained through the China Statistical Yearbook, and the number of tourists in Shandong Province is fitted and predicted by the time series model, gray model and gray-BP neural network combination model. The experimental results obtained prove that the improved gray-BP neural network combined model provides most ideal results.

articleTitle: A Frequency Reconfigurable Circularly Polarized Antenna Based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A frequency reconfigurable circularly polarized antenna using liquid metal is proposed in this letter, the antenna is composed of a truncated-corners square slotted patch and a slot-microstrip coupling structure. The method for designing a circularly polarized radiation patch and the fluidity of liquid metal is used here: 1) introducing four corner cuts and a rectangular slot to realize the circular polarization characteristics; and 2) injecting the liquid metal into different zones to control the operating frequency of the antenna. The simulation results show that the proposed circularly polarized antenna can be tuned to work in three different frequencies.

articleTitle: A Low Energy Consumption LDPC Coding Technology Applied to the Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Following the development of the 5G technology, wireless IoT communication is becoming reality. Therefore, how to cut the cost of energy in the channel transmission is coming to the forefront of the wireless IoT communication field. To solve this problem, a low energy consumption LDPC coding technology is presented. It includes two parts: a coding preprocessing system and LDPC coding system. The biggest problem of channel transmission is that the high and low levels in the signal change very frequently, which costs a lot of extra energy. In this paper, a scheme aiming at cutting the cost of the energy in channel transmission is presented. The frequency of signal’s changing between the low and high levels is decreased without any designs of complex coding algorithms. And with the amount of information increasing, the effect of decreasing the energy costs in the channel will be significant

articleTitle: Microwave Penetration Depth Measurements of Plant Materials in Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Using reverberation chambers (RCs) to carry out measurements of materials is a common means. In this letter, we adopt two experiments: measuring the average absorption cross section (ACS) of different states of plant materials and measuring the microwave penetration depth inside different plant materials. Combined with our results, it is helpful for industrial processing of plant materials.

articleTitle: Research on Low SNR Mono-pulse Detection Algorithm for Space-borne Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The space-borne pulse receiver will detect the pulse signal passing through the ionosphere, which amplitude attenuation and phase change of each frequency are relatively random. Conventional pulse detection and time-frequency methods with rapid development recently may be improper to detect the time-varying mono-pulse effectively on low SNR. Firstly, after analyzing the time-frequency characteristics of pulse signal, a Short-time Cross-correlation detection method based on matched inner product is proposed. The initial value of the cross-correlation base is derived from the typical sample processing. The estimation value can be obtained by inner product calculation with the pulse signal in the sliding window range. On this basis, combined with the estimation of frequency characteristics, the composite detection of tracking several sliding windows beyond the sensitive threshold is carried out, which further improves the detection rate. Finally this method can realize the detection under low SNR which also lays the foundation for the signal reconstruction and recognition.

articleTitle: Impacts of Phase Noise on the Performance of Adaptive Side-lobe Cancellation System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Adaptive side-lobe cancellation (SLC) is an effective means of anti-jamming in communication systems. To realize SLC in digital domain, down-conversion is required to convert the signals into baseband. However, down-conversion circuits introduce phase noise into the output signals, which degrades the SLC performance. This paper establishes new mathematical models of SLC taking into account phase noise to quantify the impacts of phase noise of different levels. The theoretical models are verified by simulations. The simulation results show that phase noise is a critical factor that limits the interference cancellation ratio (ICR) of SLC. In addition, the effect of phase noise is not related with the specific form of the received signals, but only the level of phase noise. The theoretical models in our paper can be used to find the required phase noise levels to meet the required SLC performance.

articleTitle: Design of Wearable Health Monitoring System Integrating Wireless Technology Based on 3D Graphene Foam Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wearable health monitoring system based on wireless data transmission technology is designed for heart and blood health monitoring. In this system, new three-dimensional (3D) graphene foam sensors are used to capture heart rate signals in real time, and a microprocessor STM32 is used as the main control chip for sending the collected data to the mobile device through low-power Bluetooth. Meanwhile, the blood oxygen and blood pressure data are collected by the mobile device, and then, the acquired physical health data and location information are packaged, stored and sent to the cloud server through 4G communication circuit, so the remote monitoring of the physical health of the subject in real time by the cloud server can be realized.

articleTitle: Improvement of the MIMO Performance of an Antenna Array Using Dielectric Substrates
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A method of improving the diversity measure and capacity of single-polarized antenna array in non-isotropic multipath environments by loading dielectric substrate array is proposed. The dielectric substrate array, which is made of relatively higher wave impedance dielectric substrate periodically, is placed on top of the antenna array to enrich the wave scattering. By introducing different scatter properties when the antenna elements are excited, the correlations between the adjacent elements in the antenna array are decreased, and the array diversity measure and capacity are improved. Through applying this method to $4 \times 8$ antenna array, the potential of this method for massive MIMO array is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Active Metasurface With Dynamic Beam Steering in Microwave Region
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an active metasurface for dynamic beam steering is proposed, which are composed of meta-atoms with varactor diodes working in microwave region. The effective refraction index of each single meta-atom can be artificially tuned by the capacitance of diodes, for achieving the arbitrary phase value and unity reflectance. Theoretical analyses and simulation verification are performed to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed active metasurface with full 2π reflectance phase. The proposed active metasurface can work within a broad bandwidth and achieve beam steering with arbitrary angles. This work can be applied to both reflection or transmission metasurface modes, and paves a theoretical foundation for reconfigurable antenna and communication systems.

articleTitle: Compensation Method of GPS Signal Delay Based on Factor Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) have been widely used in urban environments. The satellite positioning system plays an irreplaceable role in UGVs. However, the tall buildings in cities may cause interference to the transmission of satellite signals, which results in positioning delays, thus reducing the positioning accuracy of UGVs. To address this issue, a compensation method for information delay based on factor graph model is proposed in this paper. In the factor graph model utilized, the corresponding GPS factor node will not be generated when the GPS signal delay occurs at the current fusion time. The subsequent factor graph model is directly generated by the combined navigation system of visual odometry (VO) and inertial measurement unit (IMU). When the delayed GPS signal arrives, the measurement data of VO and IMU are used to compensate the delayed GPS positioning information. The compensated GPS positioning information is used to generate an additional factor node at the moment when the GPS signal actually arrives. This additional factor node is connected into the factor graph model for data fusion so that the delayed GPS positioning information can still be used to correct the positioning error. The method proposed in this paper effectively reduces the positioning error while taking into account the real-time performance. Experimental simulations show that the proposed method can reduce the positioning error while GPS signal delay occurs.

articleTitle: Modified Generalized Memory Polynomial Model of RF Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a modified generalized memory polynomial (MGMP) model is proposed for digital predistortion. Using this model to characterize the power amplifier and establish an inverse model can compensate the nonlinear distortion of the power amplifier well. This model changes the form of the envelope terms and deletes some cross terms, which reduces the number of coefficients greatly. The performance of the proposed model is evaluated by linearizing a power amplifier which works at 6GHz. Experiments have proved that this model maintains the performance close to the GMP model while reducing a large number of coefficients.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of Planar Near Field for Antenna Phase Center Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper expatiates on the definition and solution of antenna phase center in planar near field. It provides the method of error analysis modeling and the 18 error items of phase pattern. And the final boundary of the error is obtained by error synthesis method. Based on error matrix, Monte Carlo method is employed for error analysis of phase center.

articleTitle: W-Band Waveguide Slot Array Antenna with High Gain Based on Rectangular Micro-Coaxial Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a W-band waveguide slot array antenna based on rectangular micro-coaxial process. To reduce the overall dimension of the array antenna and facilitate testing, the CPW interface is used for excitation. And a broadband CPW to waveguide transition is designed. The overall dimension of the array antenna is 17.85 mm × 7.4 mm × 0.5 mm. The bandwidth is around 8.7 GHz (96.1-104.8 GHz) and the simulated realized gain is up to 18 dBi.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Pattern Design for MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a method for calculating the dominant orthogonal patterns in different sizes of array apertures that maximizes the corresponding diversity gain for a given multipath environment. Simulation results demonstrate the performance of the computational optimal patterns.

articleTitle: Cooperative Interference Decision Based on Directed Mutation Search Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The rapid development of electronic technology and weapons and equipment has promoted the transformation of the war situation. Electronic warfare has become more and more important in modern warfare. Reasonable interference decision-making according to the battlefield environment can achieve better combat results. Therefore, the interference decision-making link is in a very critical position in combat. For different confrontation environments, obtaining appropriate interference allocation schemes can improve the interference effect and overall revenue, and to some extent, reduce the loss of interference resources and equipment. In terms of the static multi-jammer cooperative interference decision algorithm, this paper aims at the current common optimization algorithms that are greatly affected by human factors and the search method is inefficient, and proposes an improved artificial bee colony algorithm based on directed mutation to solve static multi-interference machine coordination interferes decision-making issues. Simulation shows that the optimization ability and convergence speed of the artificial bee colony algorithm based on directed mutation have been improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Wireless Coverage Optimization Scheme based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As an important integral part of 5G network construction and operation strategy, the efficient utilization and management of wireless fidelity(Wi-Fi) pose huge challenges. In this context, this paper proposes a wireless coverage optimization scheme based on ray tracing. Taking the scene in the high-speed rail carriage as an example, this paper analyzes the problems and challenges of wireless network coverage in high-speed railway; then builds the physical and ray models of the high-speed railway(HSR) carriage through Sketchup and RT respectively, finally proposes engineering recommendations for train Wi-Fi wireless coverage to meet the target received signal strength and effective coverage requirements, including the optimal number of access points (AP) deployment, the combination of deployment location and transmitting power settings.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Trend of China's Key Core Technologies of Artificial Intelligence Based on the Technology Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To sort out the global artificial intelligence’s research hotspots and key technologies, this paper creates the main international patent classification(IPC) number co-occurrence matrix based on patents in the global artificial intelligence key core technology field in the Dawei Innojoy patent database. Based on the technology life cycle it uses a logistic model to analyze the technology life cycle characteristics of the eight key core technology areas of artificial intelligence in China. The study discovers that patent layout is important to key core artificial intelligence technologies in G06F, G06K, G06T, the A61 topic cluster and the H04 broad category. According to technology life cycle feature analysis, China's artificial intelligence is relatively active in the fields of computer vision technology, brain-computer interface technology and natural language processing technology. The next decade will be crucial for China's development of key core artificial intelligence technologies. Particularly between 2025 and 2030, most of the technologies will achieve breakthroughs and mature. In order to promote the development of key core technologies of artificial intelligence in China, different development suggestions are proposed for different technology areas of life cycle, with a view to providing reference for achieving major breakthroughs and technological leaps in key core technologies of artificial intelligence in China during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

articleTitle: Restriction on the Purity of OAM Modes Generated by Digital and Coding Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We studied the influence of digital metasurfaces with different phase quantization levels on the purity of OAM modes, and proposed the concept of phase sampling frequency. It is verified by simulation, and the results are in good agreement with the theory.

articleTitle: Terahertz GaN Schottky Varactor Based on Inverted Trapezoidal Metal-brim Terminal Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: GaN Schottky barrier varactor based on inverted trapezoidal metal-brim terminal structure was first proposed for terahertz frequency multiplier application. Compared with conventional varactor, simulation results show that inverted trapezoidal metal-brim structure effectively increases capacitance modulation capability, reduces the tunneling current and improves the breakdown characteristics. Thus, the proposed terminal structure could optimize the performance of GaN terahertz frequency multiplier, which could be widely used in Terahertz communication regions, imaging systems, radiometers, and so on.

articleTitle: Ultra-thin and Heat Resistant Absorber with Multi-sized Through-holes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An ultra-thin heat resistant absorber with multi-sized through-hole structure is presented in this paper. The overall thickness of the absorber is only 1mm. The design is based on the absorption of N5 ferrite material and the regulation of absorbing frequency band by multi-dimension through-hole structure. According to the simulation, the absorbing rate achieves more than 80% in the working frequency band of 8-18 GHz under the incidence of liner polarized wave. Compared with N5 ferrite material, the multi-dimension through-holes decrease the weight by about 22.5%. Owe to its thinness and lightness, it will have more applications in the field of aerospace.

articleTitle: Wideband Dual-polarized Antenna With Stable Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband ± 45° dual-polarized dipole antenna with stable radiation pattern is proposed. The antenna consists of four dipoles, a shaped reflector and a broadband feeding network. To realize ± 45° dual-polarize radiation pattern, the dipoles are formed as a square loop and fed by the feeding network. The feeding network is formed by four baluns and two 1-to-2 power dividers. The baluns and the power dividers are used to feed the dipoles for achieving better performance in impedance matching and bandwidth. The square reflector is employed to stabilize the radiation. With this method, the antenna obtains the impedance bandwidth for 58.5% (|S11|>15 dB within 2.3–4.2 GHz), and the 3-dB beamwidth of the proposed antenna is within 65° ± 5° in the horizontal plane.

articleTitle: Antenna-inspired Metamaterial Absorber with Low-profile, Wideband, and Fully Improved Angle Insensitive Performances
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Inspired by the reciprocity theorem widely applied in antenna engineering, a new design method, based on omnidirectional radiation pattern synthesis and relative absorption pattern conversion, is proposed. And the design method mainly consists of two parts, in which the characteristic mode theory is used to guide the underlying modal behaviors and the dissipation tailoring is used for power exhaustion and impedance matching. Based on the design method, a mushroom-type unit-atom of absorber is proposed, and it is covered with resistive sheets. The simulated results demonstrate that, from 1.9 GHz to 4.2 GHz, the large-incident angle absorption of TM wave can be up to 82°, and the 90% absorption of TE plane wave can be up to 45°.

articleTitle: Study on Extracting Method of Distributed Parameters for Non-uniform Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, in order to solve the problem about extracting the distributed parameters of 3D vertical bending non-uniform transmission lines, the model of this structure composed of two conductors is studied, and the time domain method for extracting the distributed parameters is discussed. The time domain method is given by analyzing the port characteristics of non-uniform transmission lines and researching the relationships between port parameters. Then, the lumped equivalent circuit model for this non-uniform transmission lines is established, and the S-parameters of ports in equivalent circuit model are calculated. Compared S-parameters obtained by the time domain method and equivalent circuit method, the validity and correctness of the time domain method for extracting the distributed parameters of 3D vertical bending non-uniform transmission lines are verified.

articleTitle: Single-Feed Reflectarray Antenna with Eight Beams for Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reflectarray antenna can achieve contoured multi-beam patterns by controlling the phase distribution of the reflectarray. In this paper, a single-feed K-band reflectarray antenna with eight beams pointing to different directions is achieved by the alternating projection method (APM). The proposed reflectarray antenna contains 344 elements which are printed on a single-layer substrate. Both the calculation results and simulation results demonstrate that the proposed antenna can generate eight beams with acceptable side-lobe level.

articleTitle: Research of Occupancy-Based Skyline Pattern Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The DOFRA algorithm uses user-specified minimum support threshold and occupancy threshold to find frequent and complete patterns. This process requires constant modification of threshold to adapt to different datasets. From a macro point of view, there is a negative correlation between the pattern support and the pattern length (occupancy), and user-specified minimum threshold mining has a large deviation to the result. In this article, by designing an efficient Pattern-extension-list (PEL) structure to replace the occupancy upper bound calculation in the DOFRA algorithm, a skyline mining algorithm based on the occupancy upper bound calculation (SOPM-occubound) is proposed. Two types of Skyline algorithms based on the PEL structure, SOPM (candidate set) and SOPM-occumax (without candidate itemsets), are used to mine occupancy-based skyline patterns (OBSPs). The advantage of SOPM is that the unreasonable setting of the threshold results in the problem of extremely different data excavated, and it can effectively find the most representative modes in the two dimensions of support and occupancy, and dominate other modes. Finally, the experimental results on several real and simulated datasets show that SOPM algorithm based on PEL structure is superior to SOPM-occubound in terms of running time and memory usage, and SOPM-occumax algorithm does not generate candidate item sets, thus it is the most efficient.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Level Suppression of Nulling Synthesis With Wide-beam Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper focuses on the sidelobe level (SLL) suppression problem with a desired wide nulling via a wide-beam array antenna. To deal with this problem, the existing methods synthesize the wide nulling based on the beam pattern optimization. However, in real applications, the array power gain is a more concerned factor than the beam pattern. Hence, differently, the paper tries to solve the SLL suppression problem by optimizing the array power gain. The formulated synthesis problem based on power gain optimization is non-convex. To simplify the problem-solving, the original problem is converted to a convex on by approximating the complex-valued constraint with real-valued constraint, as a result, it can be solved with existing tools. Both the isotropic element pattern (IEP) and the active element pattern (AEP) are used to assess the performance of the proposed algorithm. The simulation results indicates that the proposed algorithm can further suppress the SLL about 3 dB to 8 dB while keeps the same power gain and obtains the desired nulling.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Device Modeling Based on Dynamic Neural Networks: A Review of Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper reviews the recent modeling methods of nonlinear devices including dynamic Neuro-space mapping (Neuro-SM), time delay neural network (TDNN) and Wiener-type dynamic neural network (Wiener-type DNN). The dynamic Neuro-SM combines dynamic neural networks with existing models to reflect the dynamic characteristics of nonlinear devices. The TDNN and the Wiener-type DNN are dynamic neural networks to train input-output relation of nonlinear devices. The formulations of dynamic Neuro-SM, TDNN and Wiener-type DNN are presented allowing the training with dc, small signal, and large signal data. The modeling example of GaAs MESFET device illustrates that the Wiener-type DNN model can fast and accurately model microwave nonlinear devices and has good convergence and robustness.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Wide Beamwidth Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A miniaturized wide beamwidth dielectric resonator antenna is presented. The wedge-shaped concave structure is introduced to enhance the phase delay between the different positions on the same aperture. Some metal patches are attached on the side walls of concave structure and the top of dielectric resonator antenna to miniaturize the antenna. The resonant frequency of the proposed antenna can be reduced by 26.2%, with excellent half-power beamwidth performance of 165.4° and 179.8° in the E- and H-planes at 24 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Impedance Matching Approach with Oblique Waveguide for Arbitary Rectangular Waveguide Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A numerical model of generalized scattering matrix for the H-plane oblique waveguide is established in this paper, based on the mode matching method and the scattering matrix cascade principle of microwave network. And the impedance matching characteristics of the H-plane oblique waveguide are described detailedly. Besides, an optimum design method and procedures of the oblique waveguide utilizing to match a rectangular waveguide device is proposed. As an application example, we adopt this method and the oblique waveguide to design a waveguide H-T 3dB power divider. The result shows that the improved 3dB power divider has high transmission efficiency and low field enhancement effect. Therefore, the oblique waveguide has great potential in matching the high power rectangular waveguide devices.

articleTitle: A Recognition Method of OAM based on Diffraction Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Orbital angular momentum has attracted a lot of attention due to its potential to increase communication capacity. However, the recognition of orbital angular momentum has always been a difficult problem. This paper proposes an orbital angular momentum recognition method based on diffraction neural network, and the simulation is done with CST software. The good results were obtained.

articleTitle: A Ji-Shaped Chinese-Character Millimeter-Wave Antenna for 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A Ji-shaped Chinese-character patch antenna is proposed for future communications. The proposed antenna is comprised of two dielectric layers. Ji-shaped patch is etched on the upper surface of the top layer, whereas a feeding network is designed in the other layer. Furthermore, the conformal Ji-shaped antenna is designed to be placed on the surface of the cylindrical objects. Simulated results demonstrate that a gain of 7.9±0.3 dBi over the whole operating frequency band (24.7527.5 GHz) can be obtained.

articleTitle: A Wideband Vertically Polarized Omnidirectional Antenna for Indoor 2G/3G/LTE/5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband vertically polarized (VP) omnidirectional antenna is presented for the 2G/3G/LTE/5G communication systems in this work. The proposed antenna is composed of a ground plane, a center-fed discone with a dual-sleeve structure, and a top-loading circular patch that is printed with four U-slots and four arc-shaped slots. Here, the top circular patch is connected to the ground plane by using four shorting legs. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed antenna achieves an enhanced impedance bandwidth of 0.68-4 GHz for |S11|≤-15 dB. Besides, it can radiate omnidirectionally in the horizontal plane, which can be widely applied in indoor distributed communication systems.

articleTitle: Wnet ++: A Nested W-shaped Network with Multiscale Input and Adaptive Deep Supervision for Osteosarcoma Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel and more powerful architecture W-net++ was proposed based on two cascaded U-Nets and dense skip connections to realize the automatic and more accurate segmentation of osteosarcoma lesion in computed tomography (CT) images. In this network, multiscale inputs were applied to the architecture to recover the missing spatial details caused by multiple encoding and subsampling of the encoder; adaptive deep supervision was introduced to guide the multi-scale learning of the network to speed up convergence and improve the performance of the network; channel attention module (CAM) was incorporated to selectively emphasize the interdependent channel graphs and further improve the feature representation of the model. We have evaluated the proposed architecture and compared it with the-state-of-the-art methods by 5-fold cross validation on a home-built dataset of osteosarcoma CT images. Our experiments demonstrated that our method achieves an average DSC gain of 6.17 points, 1.91 points, 1.55 points over U-Net, U-Net++, MSRN, respectively.

articleTitle: Measurement and Ray-Tracing Simulation for Millimeter-Wave Automotive Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The underlying requirement of autonomous driving test orienting the future Internet of Intelligent Vehicles (IoIV) needs knowledge of authentic millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar simulation system. In this paper, a mmWave radar measurement system, which is validated by two corner reflectors with a constant radar cross-sectional (RCS), is set up to carry out the parallel parking measurement campaign on road. The key characteristics of the measurement, including Range-Power profile, Range-Doppler spectrum, and Range-Angle spectrum are obtained and analyzed for the subsequent ray tracing (RT) simulation. The RCSs of key targets are estimated based on the measurement results and provide a visible cue for calibrating EM parameters, which are then matched with the measured ones. The calibrated simulation results are then compared with the measurement results, which realizes the closed-loop verification and analysis.

articleTitle: The Using of “Sipejar” to Support the Online Teaching-Learning Process in College Based on Gender, Year of Study, and Department
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Many universities develop application systems to support an effective teaching-learning process. One of the application systems developed is “Sipejar” (learning information system). Due to the pandemic of Covid 19, the process of learning and teaching is mostly done online, so that the use of the Sipejar is increasingly being carried out. However, until now, how to use the application system, has not been studied deeply. What variables affect the intensity of using the application is still a question. Therefore, it is needed to study this problem. The purpose of this study was to describe the use of “Sipejar” in online instruction, and to test the effect of the gender, study year, and department on the intensity of use of the Sipejar Application. The research was conducted at the State University of Malang using a survey research design. The data collection technique used a questionnaire with a sample of 82 students taken through random sampling. The data analysis technique used descriptive statistics, analysis of variance, and qualitative data analysis techniques. The results indicated that students used various “Sipejar” techniques in online learning. There is no significant difference in the frequency of using “Sipejar” by gender, but there is a significant difference in terms of study years, and department.

articleTitle: Terahertz Channel Measurement and Characterization on a Desktop from 75 to 400 GHz
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The emerging technology terahertz (THz) communication is envisioned to provide high-data-rate wireless links. The wide swath of the unused and unexplored spectrum makes it a significant candidate for the sixth-generation mobile communications (6G). In this paper, a series of channel measurements are conducted on an optical table to characterize the wireless channel on a desktop, which is an important use case for THz communications. The measured frequency range is from 75 GHz to 400 GHz, which has covered the main band planed for 6G within THz band. Eight frequency bands with ultrawide bandwidth are measured dividually in order to explore how the channel characteristics change along with frequency. By comparison of the power delay profiles (PDPs) between measurements and ray-tracing (RT) simulations, the measured multipaths can be physically interpreted. Moreover, with the aid of this self-developed RT simulator, electromagnetic (EM) property of the painted metal (which is the relevant material generating multi-order reflected paths in the measurements) is extracted, finding that the imaginary part of the relative permittivity is considerably small compared to the perfect conductor because of the painting. Last but not least, the key channel parameters, in terms of root-mean-square (RMS) delay spread and Ricain K-factor, are analyzed and modeled with frequency. In the future, with the help of RT simulations, the angular characteristics will be supplemented to complete the three-dimensional (3D) channel data towards a thorough understanding of channel characteristics for THz communications in the 6G era.

articleTitle: AoI Optimal Dynamic Power Control for IoT networks: A DRDPG Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Information freshness is crucial for time-critical IoT applications, since stale information will significantly affect the reliability and accuracy of decisions. This paper investigates the dynamic power control policy for IoT networks to optimize the information freshness, in terms of age of information (AoI), where the status update arrivals at source nodes (SNs) are stochastic. To reduce signaling overheads, the BS can observe the information freshness of the update packets stored at SNs only when the packets have been successfully delivered. To this end, we first formulate the AoI optimal dynamic power control problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with the continuous action space, where neither the instantaneous AoI at SNs nor channel power gains are known to the BS at the time of decision making. Then, we have proposed a deep recurrent deterministic policy gradient (DRDPG)-based power control (DRPC) algorithm to minimize the weighted average AoI at the BS. Finally, simulations are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm by comparing it with baseline algorithms.

articleTitle: Cooperative Jamming Resource Allocation Based on Integer-Encoded Directed Mutation Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electromagnetic countermeasure (ECM) is of extreme importance in modern warfare. In order to confront the threat of radar-net, cooperative jamming platform with multiple jammers is the main approach. A proper allocation of jamming resource is required before and during the process of interference. This paper proposes an artificial bee colony (ABC) based jamming resource allocation (JRA) algorithm with few parameter adjustments. The allocation strategy is encoded in integer to better handle the constraints of JRA problem. Furthermore, a genetic algorithm (GA) inspired solution update method is introduced in stages of algorithm to accelerate the convergence rate. Simulation result shows that the proposed algorithm has a better performance in both rate and precision of convergence compared with tabu search artificial bee colony algorithm (TSABC) and ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO), which were adopted in previous related studies.

articleTitle: Joint Placement Design and Beamforming in Intelligent Reflecting Surface Assisted Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) is a new technology which can reconFigure wireless channels and improve its performance. In this paper, we propose a new way to solve IRS assisted wireless transmission problem when there are two couples of base stations and users which have different weighting, and IRS is in a given location. In this situation, alternating optimization and semidefinite programming relaxation(SDR) is applied to solve the problem. Then we further consider location of IRS deployment to maximize the signal performance. While the problem is hard to solve directly, we design a algorithm to acquire the sub-optimal value, and simulation results show that the proposed solution can significantly improve signal performance, and more efficient than a heuristic scheme.

articleTitle: Stroke Motor Imagery Recognition based on EEG
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Motor imagery based brain computer-interface systems have been widely used in motor rehabilitation after stroke. An effective algorithm is very important whether it is for the analysis of the neuroplasticity results of brain injury or for the external mechanical skeleton to assist the movement of the affected side in patients with dyskinesia. This paper proposes a long short - term memory(LSTM)-Fully connected(FC)-LSTM model to enhance the learning ability of LSTM units. According to the characteristics of high time resolution of electroencephalography(EEG) signals, the lifting wavelet transform is introduced to remove noise, and the proposed framework is used to process the time series EEG signal. After adjusting the parameters of the model, we analyzed the EEG signals of 12 stroke patients while performing right/left hand motor imagination task, in order to improve the algorithm performance and to reduce the offline calibration time. The proposed framework aims to further localize brain injury area and to quantify brain injury degree.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement Strategy of University Internal Governance Effect Based on the TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The internal governance effect of a university is a concentrated expression of the university’s governance ability and level, and it is also the core element that affects the realization of multiple functions such as knowledge production and social services of the university. In order to explore a feasible path for promoting efficient university governance and optimizing the governance mechanism, this paper aims at the 10 key influencing factors based on the theory of innovative problem solving (TRIZ), and transforms the key influencing factors into 10 key issues of university internal governance, and uses them as standard factors to establish a related model. This paper draws lessons from the 40 principles of invention and innovation in TRIZ, combines literature research and expert interviews to establish a strategy set on university governance, and formulates targeted strategies to improve the effectiveness of university internal governance.

articleTitle: Data Collection of Wireless Sensor Network with Grid Structure Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The key issue in studying data collection in wireless sensor networks is how to reduce the amount of data transmitted by the sensor nodes, thus making the overall energy consumption of the network reduced and the survival period extended. In this paper, a data collection method based on compressed sensing for wireless sensor networks with grid structure is proposed. The method is designed with the overall energy consumption and overall transmission delay of the network in mind. First, for the case that sensor nodes are uniformly distributed in the detection area, the overall energy consumption and overall transmission delay of the network after applying compressive sensing are calculated to obtain the optimal number of grids. Secondly, this paper proposes a routing algorithm to make the subtree of sink balanced, and applies it to data collection, which can achieve the effect of reducing the overall transmission delay and balancing the overall energy consumption of the network. Finally, simulation experiments are designed to verify the method. The results of simulation experiments show that the proposed method can reduce the network energy consumption and extend the network lifetime in the applied scenarios.

articleTitle: Robust Beamforming Method for Coprime Array with Accurate Covariance Matrix Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In comparison to the Uniform Linear Array (ULA) with the same quantity of physical array elements, the coprime array has augmented array aperture and effectively reduces the mutual coupling effect among array elements. There are many potential advantages in resolution performance and interference rejection ability. Based on coprime array, this paper presents a robust adaptive beamforming (RAB) method. As a result of deducing the continuous elements in the differential optimization array of the coprime array, we obtain a virtual ULA that is significantly longer than a real linear array and the Toeplitz matrix of the virtual array is constructed to estimate the accurate interference direction, interference power and noise power to rebuild the interference plus noise covariance matrix (INCM). By correcting the estimated signal steering vectors (SVs), the proposed method has improved performance when the signal look direction error and array element position error exist. This method is robust and effective, as demonstrated by results from computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on BDS/GPS High-precision Long-period Ephemeris Extrapolation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the surface satellite positioning efficiency of the underwater vehicle, a simple and efficient high-precision long-period ephemeris extrapolation technology method is proposed to solve the problem of too long time for the first satellite positioning of the submarine after a long underwater navigation. This method effectively shortens the satellite positioning time by constructing the ephemeris parameter extrapolation model and the satellite long-period clock error prediction model. The simulation experiment results show that the satellite orbit forecast output by the model meets the requirements of equipment accuracy, and the satellite positioning time is significantly shortened.

articleTitle: Recognition of MFR Based Motif Discovery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi-function radar (MFR) has pulse-level parameter agility, and under the scheduling of complex procedures, it can adjust resource allocation in an optimal way to perform multiple tasks in different directions. The agility of the parameters makes it difficult to describe MFR statistically, and traditional statistical description methods based on signal characteristics are difficult to support the needs of MFR recognition tasks. Another potential MFR description method is using the high-dimensional temporal pattern hidden in pulse stream, which is represented by the pulse repetition interval (PRI) switch rule and value range. This paper uses motif mining algorithm to find high-dimensional repeated patterns in MFR pulse stream, and the key PRI sequence of MFR is obtained through further screening. Then, multiple key sample sequence matchers are integrated into a matching degree generator, which is used to output the matching degree between the MFR to be identified and the reference MFR. Simulation results show that compared with the deep learning method, it has better performance and stronger interpretability.

articleTitle: The Nyström Kernel Adagrad Least Mean Square Algorithm Using k-means Sampling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The kernel least mean square (KLMS) using the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method has been proposed successfully in a Gaussian noise. However, KLMS suffers from performance degradation in terms of convergence rate and filtering accuracy. To this end, an adaptive gradient (Adagrad) optimization algorithm is used to find the solution to the least mean square of error, and the Nyström method is applied into KLMS to reduce its computational and spatial complexity, generating an online Nyström kernel Adagrad least mean square (NKALMS) algorithm. To further improve the filtering accuracy of NKALMS, another online Nyström kernel Adagrad least mean square algorithm using k-means sampling (NKALMS-K) is developed in this paper. Monte Carlo simulations on time series prediction demonstrate that the NKALMS-K algorithm outperforms KLMS and its extensions in the presence of Gaussian noise from the aspects of accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Receiver in Visible Light Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: White light emitting diodes have rapidly occupied a place in the field of indoor lighting equipment due to their advantages of low power consumption, long life and green safety, and have made great contributions to the application and development of indoor visible light communication. Based on the study of the uniformity of the received power and signal-to-noise ratio distribution of the line-of-sight link and the non-line-of-sight link, a design scheme of the multi-detector combined optical receiver is proposed. Taking the combination of double detectors and three detectors as an example, the combination scheme of tilt angle and azimuth angle with the most uniform distribution of received power and signal-to-noise ratio is studied. Finally, it is concluded that the optical receiver of this three-dimensional combination can receive a more uniform distribution of signal power by using a simple power addition fusion method under the combination of specific tilt angle and azimuth angle, but it has no effect on improving the signal-to-noise ratio index. On the contrary, the single receiver without horizontal placement has good effect.

articleTitle: Use of a Priori Geometric Information to Improve the Identification of the B-field Measurement Around a Power Electronic Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electromagnetic interference between power electronic systems often causes malfunctions. This problem of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) has become an essential issue for the electronic components’ design. In order to take the coupling into account during the industrial design phase, a predictive method was proposed, based on the multipole expansion in spherical harmonics of the magnetic induction field measured around each system. The accuracy of the characterization depends on several factors such as the number of measurements, the position of the measuring points, the sensitivity of the measuring instruments, and so on. In addition to the measurements, a priori information on the device is often available, allowing us to improve the accuracy of the identification. In this work, the properties of the expansion in spherical harmonics are linked to the a priori information (particularly geometric) and it is shown how this information can be used to improve the identification problem. In practice, the a priori information is often accompanied by some bias, which also needs to be considered. The methods will be illustrated by a few examples, such as a smoothing inductance.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the First-class Engineering Discipline Construction: A Method Based on D-Number Preference Relation Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The evaluation method of D-number preference matrix theory can overcome the inaccuracy of evaluation results caused by the uncertainty of experts’ evaluation opinions in traditional evaluation. This paper takes the evaluation of the construction effect of first-class engineering discipline as the research object. First of all, the evaluation system of the construction effectiveness of first-class engineering discipline oriented to discipline performance is constructed. Then, a new MCDM method is proposed, which is the evaluation method of D-number preference relation matrix. By setting ideal values and taking them as the benchmark, the preference relationship among evaluation objects is obtained, and then the evaluation model of the construction effectiveness of first-class engineering discipline oriented to the discipline performance is constructed. Finally, a case study of material science and engineering disciplines in three universities is carried out to obtain the rank of the effectiveness evaluation of the discipline construction and the different evaluation values which varies with the difference degree $\lambda$. The research results verify the reliability and effectiveness of the established evaluation model, make the evaluation results of each evaluation object independent and stable, innovate the evaluation method of first-class discipline construction effectiveness, and expand the application range of D-number preference relation matrix.

Author Keywords: effectiveness evaluation of the first-class discipline construction

publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Active Frequency Selective Surface with Switchable Transmission and Reflection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes an active frequency selective surface (AFSS) with switchable transmission and reflection in dual bands. The AFSS is a multi-layered structure with two metallic layers and three dielectric layers. By controlling the switching states of the PIN diodes placed in the upper and lower metallic layers, we can get reconfigurable performance of the AFSS. The combination of the “ON” and “OFF” states of all the PIN diodes can help to achieve the transition between transmission and reflection in C-band and X-band. The numerical simulation results agree well with the theoretical analysis. The proposed metasurface can find wide range of applications in frequency selective filter and radome.

articleTitle: Verification Circuit for Multi-function Chip Serial Signal Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The use of serial control signal in a multi-function chip can reduce the number of chip input ports, thereby reducing chip area and saving costs. However, during chip testing, there may be errors in signal logic or timing generated by the external serial signal controller. This paper designs a verification circuit for a serial signal controller. It converts the serial signal generated by the controller into a parallel signal according to the requirements of the multi-function chip. It is convenient for the logic and timing test when the verification circuit is used. The verified serial signal controller can control the multi-function chip normally, and realize receiving and transmitting state, and set different phase shift and attenuation value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Collaborative Interference Decision Based on Improved Contract Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electronic warfare has become more and more important in modern warfare and has gradually become the main method of warfare. According to the battlefield environment, making a reasonable interference decision is a very critical position in combat. There are some problems with dynamic interference decision algorithms, such as low utilization of interference resources and low efficiency of dynamic adjustment. In view of the above shortcomings, this paper proposes an improved contract network algorithm to make dynamic interference decision. The simulation shows that the optimization ability of the improved contract network algorithm is better than that of the previous contract network algorithm.

articleTitle: Comparison of Shielding Effectiveness Measured by Using Absorption Clamp Method and Reverberation Chamber Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The shielding effectiveness of a cable has been measured using two different methods in this paper. Results show that inconsistence exists and more investigations are required on these two methods.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Linear Sub-array based on Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper proposes a hybrid method based on generic algorithm (GA) and convex optimization algorithm (CO) for linear sub-array synthesis, where each sub-array contains two elements. The periodicity of array can be broken by thinning some elements. The array configuration is optimized by GA method, and the corresponding sub-array weight can be obtained by CO method. Two numerical simulations show the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Decoupling Patch Antenna Array Using Magnetic Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a thin magnetic metamaterial (TMM) for patch antenna decoupling.
