Due to the strong electromagnetic (EM) waves coupling in the dielectric substrate, a TMM with negative permeability in the working frequency band of patch antenna array embedded in the dielectric substrate is designed, which can block the propagation of EM waves in the dielectric substrate and realize the decoupling of the patch antenna array. This technique can effectively decouple the patch antenna array.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Multipath Effects on GNSS Positioning in Urban Canyon
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) can provide us with three-dimensional coordinates information of any place on the earth. However, the multipath effects always cause a decrease in GNSS positioning accuracy. In this paper, we analyze and model the root mean square (RMS) delay spread (DS) in multipath channels and the GNSS pseudo-range error (PRE) based on channel measurements in an urban canyon scenario at both 1.575 GHz and 1.207 GHz. By constructing the probability density function (PDF) of RMS DS, it is found that the PDF can be well fitted by a lognormal distribution. In addition, compared with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) standard, the mean value and standard deviation of RMS DS in the urban canyon are much smaller than those in the traditional urban micro-cellular scenario. Then, by modeling PRE as a function of the transmitter-receiver (Tx-Rx) elevation angle and RMS DS separately, the effect of the Tx-Rx elevation angle on PRE and the dependence of PRE on RMS DS are studied. It is found that the PRE increases linearly with the increases of the cotangent value of Tx-Rx elevation angle, and the fluctuation of PRE at 1.207 GHz is much larger than that at 1.575 GHz. Besides, there is a linear dependence of PRE on RMS DS, that is when RMS DS increases by 1 ns, PRE increases by 0.50 meters at 1.207 GHz and 0.53 meters at 1.575 GHz. These results are helpful for the research on multipath effects in urban canyon scenarios and the improvement of positioning accuracy for the GNSS.

articleTitle: A Novel Sea Clutter Suppression Method based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to suppress sea clutter effectively, it is necessary to estimate the center and width of the power spectrum of sea clutter accurately. Since the complex property of sea clutter, traditional methods cannot estimate the accurate parameters of power spectrum of sea clutter, which leads to the decrease of the clutter suppression performance. In this paper, a sea clutter suppression method based on neural network is proposed, where the real sea clutter datasets are taken to train the neural network. Finally, real sea clutter data is input into neural network to estimate the center and width of the power spectrum. The results show that the neural network is more accurate in estimating the spectral center and width than the traditional method. Moreover, the filter designed by the proposed method has a better clutter suppression performance

articleTitle: Research on the Reflection Coefficient of Magnetic Medium in the Time-domain Ray Tracing Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The time-domain ray tracing method (TD-RTM) is an important method for studying the multipath propagation of ultra-wideband (UWB) electromagnetic wave. According to the time-domain(TD) reflection coefficient of non-magnetic dielectric, we derived the time-domain reflection coefficient of the magnetic medium when electromagnetic wave is obliquely incident, for both vertical polarization and horizontal polarization. In order to prove the validity of the derived formula, we compared the time-domain solution with the inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT) of the frequency domain (FD) solution, and the result revealed very good consistency. The derived formula is of great significance for studying the propagation characteristics of ultra-wideband electromagnetic wave in complex environment by using time-domain ray tracing method.

articleTitle: Near-Field Analysis of Broadband Scattering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the broadband near-field scattering characteristics of targets are analyzed. Plane wave and double-ridged horn antenna are used respectively in 13GHz for near-field scattering analysis. Time-domain response of scattering objects are investigated firstly, and the waveform and time-delay are presented. Furthermore, near-field scattering coefficient (NFSC) and Generalized RCS (GRCS) are also introduced to analyze the near-field scattering characteristics of objects. Finally, four time domain characterization parameters are designed to quantitatively analyze the time domain waveform of scattering objects.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarized Omni-directional Antenna for 2G/3G/LTE/5G-C Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-polarized omnidirectional antenna for 2G/3G/LTE/5G-C band applications. The antenna mainly consists of a vertically polarized (VP) element and a horizontally polarized (HP) element. The HP element is composed of four printed dipoles and a four-way power divider, whereas the VP element is made up of two copper pieces that are placed perpendicular to each other. Simulation results indicate that the overlapping bandwidth of the dual ports is 74.3%(1.65-3.60 GHz). In addition, the port isolation is larger than 20 dB and the gain variations are within 3 dB in both the VP and HP planes.

articleTitle: Vehicle-to-Vehicle Radio Channel Characteristics for a Long-Distance Urban Congestion Scenario at 5.9 GHz
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A V2V radio channel measurement campaign with a maximum distance of 10 km was carried out during the congestion period in Wuhan city, China. In this paper, a short campaign description with the relevant measurement parameters is given. The received signal level is obtained from the measurement data and large variation is found. The mean excess delay and the RMS delay spread extracted from the averaged power-delay profiles, are found to be within 2 micro s and 1.5 micro s, respectively. The best-fit small-scale amplitude distribution is found to be Rayleigh distribution with the occurrence rate of 55.9%, while the TWDP and Rician distribution are estimated as the main best-fit distributions when the TX-RX distances are within 300m.

articleTitle: A Novel Miniaturized Mutil-Mode Pattern Diversity Antenna for Wearable Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel miniaturized, multi-mode, pattern diversity antenna for wearable wireless body area networks is proposed. The antenna uses even-modes to provide directional and omnidirectional radiation patterns, which can realize the miniaturization of the antenna. The omnidirectional radiation pattern is obtained by introducing a probe to excite TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> mode. The directional mode is realized by exciting the first negative order resonance (-1st mode) based on compound right-/left-hand (CRLH). Compared with the traditional patch antenna, the -1st mode works in the LH region, which is much lower than the +1st mode resonance. These CRLH resonators are realized by etching the gap on the surface of the chip and introducing short-circuit pins. The CRLH circuit consists of series and parallel inductors and capacitors provided by the above mentioned constitute. In addition, the antenna has simple structure and low profile. It only consists of patch, pins and thin metal ground, which is easy to process. Finally, the two antennas are integrated together to achieve pattern diversity, effectively save space and realize the miniaturization of the antenna. Its overall size is only 0.41λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.41λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.049λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: A Broadband Miniaturized Log-periodic Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a miniaturized log-periodic dipole antenna using Koch fractals. The proposed antenna in this paper allows the lateral area of the antenna to be reduced by Koch fractalization of the dipole. Simulation is carried out by HFSS 20.0 software, and results show that the antenna works in a frequency band ranging from 0.7 to 3.7 GHz. Across the entire frequency band, good impedance matching, high gain and good front-to-back ratio (FBR) can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Compact and Wideband UHF Tag Design Based on Artificial Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A passive anti-metal RFID tag antenna is proposed in this paper with the artificial transmission line to reduce the size. The coupled capacitance and inductance are introduced by the four metal parts at corners and interfingers, which determines the resonating frequency, and four square slots are used to fine-tune the resonant frequency. Shorting walls are attached at edges to modulate the surface current path and extend the working band. The proposed antenna topology has a low profile of 27mm $\times 17.9$ mm $\times 1.6$ mm (0.0823 $\lambda \times 0.0550 \lambda \times 0.0049 \lambda$ @915 MHz). Simulation and measured results can meet the engineering requirements with an efficient reading area of 1.1 meters under an EIRP of 630mW when tested on a 20cm $\times 20$ cm metal plate.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Spread Spectrum Communication System Based on C-T Coupling Cascade Chaotic Mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of limited number and low randomness of traditional spread spectrum codes, this paper proposes a C-T coupling cascade chaotic map with complex dynamics structure as a spread spectrum code generation algorithm. The Cosine map and Tent map are linearly coupled by coupling control factor, which increases the address space of the sequence. In addition, the coupled map and Cosine map were used as the root of the spread spectrum code, which improved the complexity of the generated sequence, so that the generated spread spectrum code had stronger pseudo-randomness. The direct spread spectrum system of C-T mapping was built through Simulink platform in Matlab, and the bit error rate of the system under different noise environment was analyzed. It was verified that the C-T coupling cascade chaotic mapping spread spectrum system has stronger anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Sampling Interval Parameter Design Based on Active Millimeter Wave Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Millimeter wave has good penetration and security, which can be better applied in security check system. The security check system needs to consider the imaging time and resolution, so it has great significance to rapidly reconstruct the imaging and improve the resolution for active millimeter-wave imaging. In this paper, the design of millimeter wave reconstruction imaging sampling interval is studied. Through analysis and experiment, the sampling interval is optimized, and the imaging results of traditional millimeter wave reconstruction algorithm and accurate millimeter wave algorithm are verified, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of active millimeter wave imaging system.

articleTitle: A High-Gain Yagi Antenna for 5G-C Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a high-gain Yagi antenna for 5G-C band is proposed. The antenna is mainly made up of two parts: a printed folded dipole feeding source with a reflector plane and a director consisting of 21 equal directing units at regular intervals. Simulation results show that a bandwidth of 3.1 to 4.0 GHz is achieved. In addition, the antenna has good directional radiation characteristics. The boresight gain is larger than 14.6 dBi over the frequency band of 3.3-3.8 GHz.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Circularly Polarized Probe Based on Vivaldi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Near-field antenna measurement has the advantages of high accuracy, good safety, and all-weather work, so it is widely used to test antennas. In this paper, a high-performance circularly polarized probe based on the vivaldi antenna is designed. We use a stripline T-type power splitter to evenly distribute the energy of the antenna port to the two feeds, ensuring that the amplitude and phase of the probe remain consistent when the probe is polarized. Its working frequency range is 0.55GHz-3.75GHz, and the axial ratio is lower than 3. The dielectric constant of the antenna dielectric plate is 2.65, and the antenna size is 325mm × 304mm × 2mm.

articleTitle: Studies on Microwave Non-Thermal Sterilization Enhanced by Ag@TiO2 Core-Shell Particles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Microwave is widely used in the inactivation of microorganisms, but its low energy efficiency and high heating temperature limit its application scenarios. This paper hopes to solve this problem by preparing microwave non-thermal effect enhancer. In this study, the inactivation performance of nano-Ag, TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and Ag@TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> on bacteria under microwave radiation were compared. The results show that Ag@TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has a unique enhancement effect on microwave sterilization.

articleTitle: A 30° Gain Suppression Omnidirectional Magneto- Electric Dipole Antenna MIMO System for Indoor Sub-6 GHz 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a 30° gain suppression vertical-polarized (VP) antenna with a 2×3 MIMO system is proposed for the 5G indoor applications. In order to suppress radiation when $\theta$=30° and increase gain on horizontal plane, three 45° single-polarized antenna elements are assembled to provide an omnidirectional radiation pattern. A magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna element is excited by a single $\Gamma$-shaped strip. Owning to the good characteristics of the antenna element, wide bandwidth and high gain have been obtained. The antenna element can provide an impedance bandwidth of 90.4% (2.0–5.3 GHz), with a stable gain of $6.0 \pm 2.2$ dBi. When $\theta$=30°, the gain is $- 2.0 \pm 4.0$ dBi. The entire volume of the antenna is $52 \times 52 \times 70$ mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. With the aforementioned traits, the antenna is well suitable for sub-6 GHz applications.

articleTitle: High Transmittance and Broadband Group Delay Metasurface Element in Ka Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: On account of the tremendous phase dispersion of the metasurface elements, most of the devices based on the metasurface have distinct large chromatic aberration. Hence, achromatism has become a research hotspot in recent years. Most of the previous achromatic principles are considered from the perspective of phase compensation. In this paper, we use the group delay principle to elliminate chromatic aberration. The group delay method is easier to understand and can achieve better performance than the phase compensation method. We propose a kind of metasurface cell with different group delay based on the group delay principle and make them continuous by polynomial fitting method. This method improves the flexibility and reduces the complexity when designing achromatic focusing lens or beam deflection gradient metasurface.

articleTitle: A Broadband Pyramidal Horn Antenna Applied to Multi-mode Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new design of a broadband pyramidal horn antenna is realized, which can be applied to multi-mode multiplexing. To achieve the purpose of multimode radiation, a four-port coaxial-line adaptor has been designed to allow for the transmission of signals of required modes TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, TEn and TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>). In addition, two circularly polarized waves with different rotation directions can be obtained by combining TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> on this basis. By controlling the amplitudes and phases of the signals from four feeding ports, the distribution of the fields in the waveguide will also be changed accordingly. The waveguide modes will be converted into radiation modes through the horn face. As a result, six different radiation patterns are acquired. The simulated results show that the simulated 10 dB return loss bandwidth is approximately 31.6% (ranging from 10.25 to 14.09 GHz, center frequency is 12. 17GHz), and the isolation is less than -20dB. The return loss coefficients of the six different modes also meet the requirements (less than -10dB) between 10.86 and 13.64 GHz.

articleTitle: Operating Frequency of Class E Power Amplifier with π Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Operating frequency of class E power amplifier with $\pi$ network is analyzed. Based on principle of class E, theoretical analysis shows that perating frequency is adjustable, waveform of current and voltage across switch is shown in time domain.

articleTitle: A Simple Method For l1-Regularized Least Square with Complex Variable
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Recently, a lot of attention has been paid to l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> regularization based methods for sparse signal reconstruction and feature selection in signal processing, statistics, and related fields. These problems can be cast as l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-regularized least square (LS) programs. Among the early research, it mainly studied on the real l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> regularization LS. To solve the real l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-regularized LS, new variable vector usually should be introduced, which increase the dimension of variable vector to be solved. In this letter a simple method for complex l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-Regularized LS is introduced, which need not introduce new variable vector. The numerical simulation shows the effective of the method.

articleTitle: Flexible Bandwidth Broadening in Topological Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Topological photonic insulators, allowing wave propagating immune to disorders at the boundary, are promisingly applicable in photonic devices called topological waveguides. However, broadband topological waveguides designs are now lacked, which limits further applications of topological waveguides. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a practical method on flexible bandwidth broadening in topological waveguides, by altering structure parameters while keeping materials unchanged. Inspired by bilayer graphene model, we construct a topological waveguide where transmission bandwidth can be broadened flexibly by adjustable interlayer couplings, while the interlayer coupling can be altered by interlayer distance. Experimental results validate the theoretical model, displaying that the relative bandwidth broadened from 7.3% to 16%. Our work focusing on bandwidth broadening will pave the way for further practical application such as perfect filters, splitters, and reflection-free delay-lines.

articleTitle: A Singly-Fed Dual-Band Antenna for Microwave and Millimeter-wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A singly-fed dual-band antenna with large frequency ratio operating at both microwave and millimeter-wave bands is presented in this paper. A 3.5 GHz monopole and a 28 GHz series-fed angled dipole array are combined together effectively and share the same aperture. An interdigital coupling structure is introduced into the lower-side of the parallel stripline, which enables the double-side parallel stripline to have two functions. It can operate as a monopole antenna at 3.5 GHz band and as a feeding structure for dipole elements at 28 GHz band. And the two types of antenna have the features of independence and their frequency range can be adjusted without affecting the other. The dual-band antenna presented in this paper is designed on a substrate Rogers 5880 with an overall size of 20×33×0.254 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, showing a compact configuration.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband Circularly Polarized Hemispherical Helical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband hemispherical helical antenna with a novel flake-like arms structure is proposed. The proposed hemispherical helical antenna has better impedance matching characteristics compared with the traditional hemispherical helical antenna. At the same time, a wideband balun is designed to match the designed antenna and coaxial connecter. By introducing resistance and absorbing materials, the axial ratio bandwidth and pattern bandwidth of the antenna are extremely widened. Simulated results show that the designed antenna has a VSWR of less than 2, an axial ratio of less than 3 dB and a gain of more than 2.5dB from 2 to 18 GHz.

articleTitle: Wideband and Wide-Angle Millimeter-Wave Scanning Phased Array Based on Metasurface for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel millimeter-wave (mmW) $4 \times 4-$ element wide-angle scanning phased array based on metasurface for 5G applications is proposed. The elements adopt non-periodic metasurface to control the aperture field distribution, which broadens the element beamwidth and thus helps improve the scanning performance. The 10-dB impedance bandwidth of the $1 \times 4-$ element subarray can cover the frequency band of 24.2529.5 GHz (20%), corresponding to the 5G mmW band. Based on the subarray, a $4 \times 4$-element planar phased array with 1-D scanning capability is designed. Furthermore, a II-shaped structure is introduced between the subarrays to achieve a non-uniform aperture field on the array surface, further improving the element beamwidth along the scanning direction and leading to a wide scanning range. The simulated results show that, within the 5G mmW band, the proposed array produces a minimal gain of 15 dBi at the broadside direction and the antenna efficiency is over 75%. The proposed phased array can cover the scanning range from ± 55° with a gain fluctuation less than 3 dB, and the maximum scanning angle of ± 60°.

articleTitle: Wideband Millimeter-Wave Endfire Antenna with Vertical Polarization for Next Generation Mobile Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A millimeter wave (MMW) metasurface-coverd vertically polarized antenna with wideband endfire radiation is presented in this work. Firstly, by placing a magnetic dipole array into two dual-layer metasurfaces and loading vertical walls at two edges of the metasurfaces, vertically polarized endfire radiation in a wide band is realized. Then, according to the symmetry of the electric filed distribution between the metasurfaces, a metal ground is introduced and the antenna’s profile is reduced by half. The final designed planar antenna is able to radiate a vertically polarized endfire pattern in the frequency range of 27.8 $\sim$ 35.0 GHz.

articleTitle: Propagation Loss Modeling for Lower UHF Band with Low Antennas in Rural Area
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Propagation loss modeling of radio wave for various situations is still gaining great attention from researchers. Most of these studies focus on cellular communication characterized by high base antenna hight. Low antenna height with short propagation range in rural area is one specific case that has not been completely investigated. The authors find that there are inadequate investigations in the open literature regarding simple and high prediction accuracy models that particularly address the lower UHF band (300-800 MHz) with low antenna height conditions. In this paper, the measured results of propagation loss at lower UHF band with low antennas are reported. We present a propagation loss model, to fill the research gap particularly associated to short range propagation conditions. The method of regression analysis of the measured data is used to obtain the parameters of the proposed model. Our proposed model is proved to well reproduce the propagation loss versus frequency and distance at lower UHF band. The root mean square error for measured versus predicted propagation loss is within 7 dB. Thus, the proposed propagation loss model is suitable for radio communication system planning assessment or design.

articleTitle: 2.5-Dimensional Switchable Frequency Selective Surface Based on Reed Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a 2.5-dimensional switchable frequency selective surface based on the active device reed switch. This structure uses reed switches instead of PIN diodes to connect the upper and bottom metal patches on the basis of 2.5 dimensions. The structure can control the connection and disconnection of the reed inside the reed switch by controlling whether the external magnetic field is applied or not, thereby controlling the switching of the structural performance. When the external magnetic field is not applied, the internal reed remains disconnected. At this time, the structure has a pass band of 0-3GHz; when a certain strength of the external magnetic field is applied to connect the internal reeds, there will be a stop band ranging from 1.90 GHz to 2.12 GHz, and the center of the stop band is 2.028 GHz. In addition, the structure has good miniaturization performance, and the unit size is only 0.08 λ× 0.08 λ.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Null Widening for Plain Array
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To counter sidelobe nonstationary interference, the mismatch between training snapshots and applied data must be solved. Limited by the computational costs, it is impossible to update the weights frequently. To solve this problem, null widening methods based on covariance matrix tapering has attracted many attentions. However, existing methods do not fit the rea12-D plain array. In this paper, a null widening method for plain array based on spatial virtual interference cluster are derived. Besides, the degrees of freedom consumed by the null widening in plain array is preliminarily analyzed, and the upper bound of the degrees of freedom is obtained. The simulation results verify that the proposed method can effectively widen the adaptive null, and the derived degrees of freedom can be viewed as a guidance for the partial adaption system, which will promote its application in engineering.

articleTitle: A Searching Algorithm for Antenna Phase Center
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces search algorithm as the new method for phase center error analysis. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is taken as an instance for searching phase center. At last, the advantages of the new method compared with the classical method are represent.

articleTitle: An I/Q Amplitude-phase Imbalance Correction Algorithm in IF Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a correction algorithm for I/Q amplitude and phase imbalance in IF receiver is proposed, which can solve the problem of image frequency caused by I/Q amplitude and phase imbalance. The test results show that in 25MHz bandwidth, 10MHz bandwidth and 1MHz bandwidth, the IRR before and after correction has been significantly improved. These test results show that most of the corrected image frequencies are submerged in spurious noise, and the image frequency suppression ratio is improved.

articleTitle: Recognition of Underground Target Material Based on Average Phase Difference and Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Recognition of the material of underground targets is always an important part of GPR (Ground Penetrating Radar) applications. According to target return time, truncating the data to remove the direct waves, and then select the typical data of the different materials target echoes. By comparing the phase of different targets with that of no target, the average phase difference is obtained. And the average phase difference is used as the input of the RBF (Radial Basis Function) neural network to realize the classification and recognition of underground target materials. Simulation result shows that this method can realize the identification and classification of common materials, such as metals, water and hole.

articleTitle: Design of Traveling-Wave Electrode for Silicon Mach-Zehnder Electro-Optic Modulator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new differential-drive traveling-wave electrode with wide bandwidth used to drive silicon-based Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) is proposed. The electrode is achieved by loading the partly removed Si substrate under the coplanar waveguide (CPW). By using the modified substrate, the transmission loss of the microwave signal can be effectively reduced compared with the signal with overlapping substrate. The bandwidth $\left(\left|S_{21}\right| \leqslant -3 \mathrm{dB}\right)$ of the presented electrode is well improved, which can reach at 28 GHz from 0.1 to 28.1 GHz. The electrode owns the merits of wide bandwidth, high phase shifting efficiency, and low cost. Thus, the proposed electrode has great values and broad prospects in the high-rate optical communication applications.

articleTitle: Design of a Wideband Stack Array Antenna For Ka-band Satellite Communication Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article presents the design of circularly polarized array antenna with the stack microstrip which works at Ka-band frequency of wideband for satellite communication application. So as to get a greater bandwidth which is demanded to include the Ka-band spectrum electromagnetic ranges of the frequency of 27 ~31 GHz, the technology of dual-layer substrate was taken advantage of. The antenna element consists of two layers parasitic circular radiator. The top patch is 2.5 mm of diameter. The bottom patch is 3.4 mm of diameter with the two side grooves of circular patch. An array of $2 \times 2$ antenna which is continuously rotated shows a 100% (24 GHz ~34 GHz) broadband 1-dB axial ratio bandwidth and 25.6%(25.5GHz ~33GHz) broadband at 2:1-VSWR. Between 26.5 GHz and 32.5 GHz, a gain which is 11 ~12.2 dB in axial direction is obtained. An array of $8 \times 8$ antenna shows a gain which is in axial direction exceeds 22 dB between 26.0 GHz ~33.0 GHz.

articleTitle: Antenna Miniaturization Using Dielectric Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a method for antenna miniaturization is proposed and two miniaturized antennas backed with dielectric cavities are designed. The dielectric cavity functions as a dielectric resonator antenna, which introduces a new resonance and reduces the antenna size while maintaining a broad bandwidth. Two antenna examples (with compact sizes of $0.32 \times 0.32 \times 0.21 \lambda^{3}$ and 0.3 $\times 0.3 \times 0.17 \lambda^{3}$, respectively) are used to demonstrate the concept. Both miniaturized antennas enjoy broadband and stable radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: A Repairing Work on Antenna Radiation Pattern Measurement Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduced several repairing works on a defection of antenna measurement instrument based on artificial neural network (ANN). In some antenna measurement systems, the turntable makes no space for probe at the bottom of the measurement system, leading to a depressed measured gain below the radiation pattern. The gain data measured by the probes on the top of the system are used as the target to train the ANN which is used for repairing the measurement with probe below. The result shows that the repairing work is antenna-related and further work is expected. In addition, the simulation data are used to assist the repairing task and it can work effectively on a specific antenna. But it didn’t solve the defection of the antenna measurement system radically.

articleTitle: A New Wide Dynamic Range Rectifier Circuit for Ambient RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new dual-band rectifier circuit for ambient radio frequency (RF) energy harvesting is proposed. Due to the existence of Schottky diode as a non-linear device in the rectifier circuit, the input impedance and echo characteristics will change dramatically with the load size and input power, so it has been challenging to design a multi-band high efficiency rectifier with high dynamic range. Therefore, an improved impedance compression technique is proposed to adjust the impedance range of nonlinear diode with high dynamic range to a smaller range.

articleTitle: A Novel Balun-Fed UWB Dipole Antenna for Borehole Pulse Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna is an important part of borehole pulse radar system. A novel balun-fed UWB antenna for borehole pulse radar with a center frequency at 350MHz and a bandwidth from 200MHz to above 900MHz is proposed in this letter. Feed of dipole elements is a novel type of balun structure, the coaxial cable loaded with ferrite magnetic rings, which solves the problem of unbalanced to balanced conversion. The antenna physical test results are in good agreement with the results offered by electromagnetic simulation software (CST), and objects about 3m underground are successfully detected.

articleTitle: Analysis of Millimeter Wave Scattering Characteristics and Imaging Effect Factors of Human Biological Tissue
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Millimeter wave has good penetration, and millimeter wave imaging technology has made great development in recent years. Therefore, millimeter wave imaging technology has great commercial value in the field of security inspection. This paper studies the electromagnetic parameters of human body and the algorithm of active millimeter wave imaging. The equivalent composite dielectric constant of human body at 94GHz was obtained through derivation, and the algorithm formula of two-dimensional millimeter wave holographic reconstruction imaging based on the principle of synthetic aperture radar was deduced, which provided a theoretical basis for the research of active millimeter wave imaging applied in security inspection field.

articleTitle: A Wi-Fi Harvesting Enabled Energy Optimization Scheme for Smart Clothing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The outbreak of the COVID-19 and the rapid aging population have made isolated medical treatment and home based care become the new norm. As a distributed wireless body sensor network (WBSN), smart clothing is of great importance for the monitoring of infectious diseases and chronic diseases. Yet, limited energy supply and real-time data transmission are challenging for regular use. In this paper, we propose an energy harvesting powered smart clothing architecture, which is optimized by reinforcement learning, PSO and static transferring algorithm to extend battery life while balancing the time delay of data transmission. To evaluate the optimization performance, the reinforcement learning, the static transferring algorithm and the particle swarm optimization(PSO) with two kinds of weight are conducted. The simulation results show that reinforcement learning has the optimal performance in terms of total cost, energy consumption and battery loss without considering the time delay.

articleTitle: Antenna Radiation Pattern Reconstruction Based on Spherical Wave Decomposition in Imperfect Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The correlation coefficient is of great significance to the antenna pattern reconstruction based on reverberation chamber (RC) measurements. The correlation coefficients between two antennas are determined by their electric fields, and the radiation components of the electric fields can be expanded into a summation of the spherical wave coefficients. In addition, the rotation pattern of the antenna to different angles can be obtained through the rotation matrix, and the correlation coefficients between the original pattern and the rotated one can also be expressed by the spherical wave coefficients. Therefore, the radiation pattern of the original antenna under test (AUT) can be reconstructed reversely by using the correlation coefficients and the rotated spherical wave coefficients. This method has been verified in a well-stirred RC. In this work, we investigate the performance of the method in an imperfect RC with a non-isotropic scattering environment.

articleTitle: A Compact Log-Period Dipole Antenna with High Gain for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A log-periodic dipole antenna (LPDA) with high gain characteristics is proposed for the fifth generation (5G) mobile communications in this paper. The proposed LPDA consists of 15 conventional dipole elements and 3 leaf-shaped dipole elements connected by feed-line. The LPDA is excited by a coaxial line. The leaf-shaped dipole elements at the end of the antenna can not only achieve good impedance matching and improved gain, but also reduce the antenna size. Simulation results reveal that the antenna can achieve the characteristics of a frequency bandwidth of 1.7 -5.0 GHz and a gain of more than 8 dBi.

articleTitle: Wide-band Filtering Power Divider Using Coupled-Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a compact wideband filtering power divider (FPD) with nice performance is presented. The required power division function is realized by the introduced looped coupled-line structure. Moreover, three coupled-lines with different terminal conditions are used to introduce multiple transmission zeros (TZs) and transmission poles (TPs). To determine the initial design parameters, the design procedure is described as much detail as possible. A prototype is designed to verify the feasibility of the proposed FPD, the experimental simulation results show 43 % fractional bandwidth centered at 5.6 GHz with more than 17 dB in-band isolation and more than 20 dB return loss at both of the two output ports.

articleTitle: A Cascaded Salty Water Attenuator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A salty water attenuator based on $\Pi$-type resistance attenuation network is proposed. It is composed of a metallic tapered parallel transmission line, a 3-D-printed container, and the salty water. By using cascaded method and the fluidity of salty water loading, the proposed design achieves a wider frequency working range, a more compact size, a lager attenuation and a better heat dissipation. Both the simulations and measurements have been conducted to verify the attenuator performance. The $\Pi$-type liquid attenuator has an attenuation of -30 dB with attenuation flatness of ± 3.2 dB operating between DC and 2 GHz (the reflection coefficient is less than -10 dB across the band).

articleTitle: An FR4-based Dual-Mode Stacked Patch Antenna with Upper Out-of-Band Suppression Using SISL Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-mode stacked patch antenna with upper out-of-band suppression using FR4 and the substrate integrated suspended line (SISL) technology is proposed in this paper. A driven patch with a slot and a parasitic patch constitute the proposed antenna. The driven patch generates the main resonance point at 3.45 GHz. The utilization of the parasitic patch not only broadens the impedance bandwidth of the patch antenna but also introduces extra resonance points in-band and a high-band radiation null. Due to etching a slot on the driven patch, the impedance matching is improved and dual modes in the band are obtained. As a result, the bandwidth from 3.28 GHz to 3.65 GHz is obtained for 5G applications, 8.68 dBi is achieved for the realized gain of the antenna. Besides, the high-band radiation null is 3.77 GHz and the upper suppression level is better than 15.4 dB.

articleTitle: Optically Transparent Diffusion Metasurface Using Metallic Mesh
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel optically transparent diffusion metasurface composed of 1-bit digital coding elements is presented. Two circular quasi-Minkowski closed-loops with different geometric scales are considered as 1-bit coding elements. The quasi-Minkowski closed-loops on the upper layer of the substrate and the back-ground on the lower layer are filled with tangential metallic ring mesh to improve the light transmittance. Low scattering is achieved by redirecting reflected EM energy to numerous directions forming a diffusion pattern through optimization of the arrangement of two coding elements. The low back-scattering characteristics with wide-angle and polarization independence below –10 dB of the diffusion metasurface are realized over a wide frequency band from 9 GHz to 16 GHz. The proposals provide new ways of manipulating the microwave scattering with simultaneously highly optical transparency in visible frequencies and demonstrate significant scientific value in practical applications.

articleTitle: A Hyperuniform Metasurface for Planar Luneburg Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A hyperuniform metasurface for planar Luneburg lens antennas is designed and demonstrated in this letter. A spatial variable refractive index is achieved by printing hyper-uniformly distributed size-varying circular patches on a dielectric substrate to approximate the Luneburg law. Compared with the previous Luneburg lens designs using periodical or quasi-periodical unit cells, the hyperuniform metasurface is isotropic and provides more stable scanning properties at different angles.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Insertion Loss and High Selectivity Bandpass Filter at the Terahertz Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In response to the issue of both the transmission performance and the selection performance of the terahertz waveguide bandpass filter, this paper proposes a terahertz waveguide bandpass filter with out-of-band dual transmission zeros. The center frequency of the filter is 342GHz, the in-band insertion loss is less than 0.4dB, and the return loss is less than 20Db. The 3-dB passband is 324-360GHz, the 30-dB fraction bandwidth is 322-363GHz, so the 30-dB rectangular coefficient is 0.88. The bandpass filter proposed in this article presents excellent performances with high frequency selectivity and low insertion loss. For terahertz band application, this high-performance bandpass filter would have a great potential.

articleTitle: Design of a Vertical Interconnection Based on Micro-additive Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The design of a rectangular-coaxial vertical interconnection structure based on micro-additive manufacturing technology is presented in this paper. This vertical interconnection is realized with quasi-coaxial structure with square cross section composed of Sn-based solder balls and is designed to connect coaxial transmission lines at different layers. Simulation results show that the insertion loss is $\lt 0.2$ dB and the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> is $\lt -20$ dB from 0.1-110 GHz. In addition, the isolation between two vertical interconnections is higher than 50 dB.

articleTitle: A Slot-based RFID Reader Antenna Design with Broad Left to Right Space Detections
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a low profile antenna for radio frequency identification devices (RFID) reader is proposed with the thickness of 15 mm and length of 450 mm. The antenna prototype is designed by etching a slot on the FR4 board supported by an alumina plate. Electromagnetic radiations will be generated within by the slot with a broad left to right spatial detection areas. Simulated and measured results show a good agreement on the working band from 886 MHz to 918 MHz, and far field radiation patterns with a maximal gain of 0 dBi. The tested results also satisfy with the practical requirements for applications.

articleTitle: Generating X band Bessel Beam Carrying OAM mode Utilizing Metasurface Integrated With SIW Source
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: How to generate a high-order Bessel beam with orbital angular momentum (OAM) has recently attracted lots of attentions. In this paper, a reflective system is presented to generate the high-order Bessel beam. The generator includes three parts: a reflective metasurface for providing phase compensations to form the high-order Bessel beam and changing the polarization mode of electromagnetic wave to make it be capable of passing through the polarized plate, a SIW source integrating with the metasurface providing a linear polarized wave, and a polarized plate to reflect the linear polarized wave generated from SIW source. Through the full wave simulation, the metasurface can realize a cyclic phase shift, And the reflective system is proven to be capable of generating the high-order Bessel beam in X band. This design features an achievement of size reduction, wide band and low cost.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Dual-Polarized Antenna For 5G Micro Basestation Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a cross dipole antenna for the fifth generation (5G) sub-6 GHz dual-band applications. The proposed antenna mainly consists of eight copper radiating patches, eight parasitic patches, and a reflector. The proposed antenna can achieve a ±45° polarization characteristic. The overlapped bandwidth is 2.77-5.31GHz, and the corresponding gain varies from 7.6 to 8.4 dBi. The gain increases with increasing operating frequency. Besides, the cross polarization level is less than -28 dB while the port isolation is larger than 26 dB.

articleTitle: Geometric Estimation on Manifolds Based Training Data Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Clutter suppression performance of STAP will be degraded greatly when exploiting contaminated training data to estimate the clutter covariance matrix. To deal with this problem, a training data selection method based on the geometric estimation on manifolds under the generalized inner product (GIP) criterion is proposed. Exploiting divergences as the geometric metric, an accurate covariance matrix is obtained. Then, combined with the GIP criterion, contaminated training data can be detected successfully. The proposed training data selection method outperforms conventional methods with small sample support, which improves the efficiency of training data selection. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Antenna with Simple Structure for 5G Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A circularly-polarized (CP) antenna with simple structure is proposed for 5G millimeter-wave (mmw) communications. The antenna is made up of two parts: an elliptical SIW backed-cavity element on the first substrate and a slotted waveguide on the second one. By simply rotating the elliptical cavity fed by a slot of the bottom waveguide, CP radiation can be yielded. Simulation results show that a frequency bandwidth of 20-30.55 GHz and an axial ratio (AR) bandwidth (<3 dB) covering 24.8-26.4 GHz are achieved. The corresponding gains are larger than 8.13 dBi across the working bands. Besides, the profile of this antenna is only 0.27λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Low-frequency Microwave Resonator for Signal Accumulation and Amplification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The microwave resonant cavity has a resonance accumulation effect on electromagnetic waves, which enables it to increase the amplitude of the received signal by combining with the receiving antenna. In this paper, a cylindrical microwave resonant cavity working at 2.45GHz is designed, and a pair of dipole antennas are connected to the input end of the cavity. Additionally, a digital switch connected to the output end of the resonant cavity controls the accumulation and release of energy in the cavity. The resonance accumulation effect of the resonant cavity is verified by comparing the output of the cavity with that of the antenna. After design and simulation, a resonant cavity with a length of 225mm and a radius of 60mm is proposed. The signal becomes a high amplitude pulse after passing through the cavity, which is 28.3dB higher than the output of the antenna.

articleTitle: Diffraction Loss Modeling for V2V Wireless Channel in Viaduct Scenarios at 5.9 GHz Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In vehicular communication scenarios, viaduct is one of common road network structures, making significant impact on the characteristics of vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) wireless channel. This paper proposes four diffraction loss models for viaduct scenarios, covering normal viaduct and ramp, viaduct and ramp with soundproof walls. It is found that the special structure of viaduct will have a significant effect on the diffraction loss of V2V wireless channel. Our analysis result shows that the normal ramp can reduce the diffraction loss by about 13 dB when the carrier frequency is 5.9 GHz band and the distance between transmitter and receiver is within 100 m. Meanwhile, the ramp with soundproof wall can reduce the diffraction loss by about 10 dB. In addition, the soundproof wall in the viaduct scenario will increase the diffraction loss by about 3.6 dB, while the additional diffraction loss caused by the soundproof wall in the ramp scenario can reach 3.6 to 6 dB. It indicates that the impact from viaduct on diffraction cannot be neglected in the vehicular channel modeling.

articleTitle: Electric Field Strength Reconstruction based on Compressed Sensing in Ascending Order
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the electric field strength data change drastically, it is difficult to reconstruct the electric field with compressed sensing(CS) using the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) basis. This paper proposes a method of electric field strength data reconstruction based on compressed sensing in ascending order. The method sorts the electric field strength data in ascending order, and then use the discrete wavelet transform basis of compressed sensing to reconstruct it. When the electric field strength data are sorted in ascending order, the sparsity of the electric field strength in the discrete wavelet transform domain has been significantly improved. We conducted simulation experiments on the electric field strength data of the half-wave dipole antenna in free space. The experimental results show that the electric field strength reconstruction effect after ascending sorting has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: A Dual-Layer Circular Polarized Transmitarray Element with Double Hexagon-Spilt Ring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-layer circular polarized transmitarray element is designed in this paper. The proposed element consists of two metal layers etched on two side of a one-layer substrate, whose relative permittivity of $\varepsilon_{r}=4.3$. In order to achieve circular polarization, the metallic layers are designed as double hexagonal split ring, where the size of these two layers are the same. By rotating a circular polarized element about its origin, it could realize a good element loss and a sufficient phase coverage with 360°.

articleTitle: Compact Broadband and Dual-Polarized Cylindrical Dielectric Resonant Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a compact broadband cylindrical dielectric resonant antenna working from 1.8GHz to 2.2GHz. First, based on two kinds of orthogonal models, we get a dual-polarized broadband antenna with a wide relative bandwidth of 20%. Then, with the proposed antenna structure, the cross polarization highly decreases. Specifically, the cross-polarization discrimination (XPD) can reach 18dB at 2.14GHz and 14dB at 1.84GHz in bore-sight direction. Finally, in such a compact size of 0.2 λ, the isolation between two ports improved by the metal post can reach 15dB on average with its minimum value of -40 dB at 2.05 GHz. The simulation verifies that the maximum radiation direction is perpendicular to substrate with the total gain of 6.4dB at 1.84GHz and 6.9dB at 2.14GHz. Thus, the characteristics of compact aperture and dual-polarization makes that the antenna can be used as miniaturized base station antenna.

articleTitle: Integrated Design of Filtering Antennas for Multiple Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Integrated design of filter and antenna has attracted intensive research interest in the past years. This paper first presents a brief overview of the advanced design methods of filtering antennas. Then, a couple of recent achievements done by the authors are demonstrated and discussed, including a dual-band filtering antenna, a circularly polarized filtering antenna, a duplexing filtering antenna, and a multiplexing antenna. The merits of each design are discussed and compared with traditional counterparts. Concluding remarks and future works are given at the end.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Wideband High Gain Planar Antenna for Radar Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-band wideband high gain planar antenna is proposed for radar applications in this paper. Two sets of radiation patches designed based on planar horn antenna with a common symmetry axis are printed on the same surface of the dielectric substrate to radiate dual band signals respectively, while the microstrip line feed structure is printed on the other surface. Simulation shows that the antenna can achieve dual-band radiation of 400MHz~548MHz and 850MHz~960MHz, realizing low-frequency radiation, suitable for detection applications. The antenna has stable unidirectional radiation and good performance in time domain. The gain ranges from 5dB to 7.75dB over the dual working bands.

articleTitle: Transparent Wideband Absorber Based on Narrow Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an optical transparent wide band absorber. The absorber consists of three parts. The top layer is made of a very narrow grooved metal square ring, the middle layer is made of a transparent dielectric substrate, and the bottom layer is made of a hexagonal metal grid structure. The simulation results show that the absorber performs well in the range of 8.0GHz to 20.5GHz, and the absorptivity is more than 90%. In addition, the absorber adopts a centrally symmetric structure, which is insensitive to polarization angle and maintains a high absorption rate at oblique incidence.

articleTitle: Effects of Environmental Temperature Changes on Electromagnetic Energy Absorption in Rats Exposed to Microwave Radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Temperature affects the metabolism of animals. Various physiological processes in animals must be carried out within a certain temperature range in order to function properly. In this paper, electromagnetic field simulations based on the finite difference of time domain (FDTD) method is used to obtain the specific absorption rate (SAR) of microwave irradiated rats at different environmental temperatures, and then the accuracy is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Shared-Aperture Multi-Band Stacked Array With ±45° Dual Polarization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A shared-aperture ±45° dual-polarized stacked antenna array covering the bands of 0.69-0.96 and 3.4-3.7 GHz for fifth-generation (5G) base station is presented in this paper. Sharing one same radiating aperture, four patch antennas in the upper band (UB) are arranged above a slot antenna in the lower band (LB). The slot antenna operates in the one-wavelength mode. The size of the proposed multi-band array is reduced substantially by changing the LB antenna into 3D bent shape. Improvement of cross-band isolation is realized due to the out-of-band suppression of the LB antenna, which is achieved by the short-circuited microstrip lines and quarter-wavelength stubs connected with the feeding microstrip lines. The simulated results verify that the proposed multi-band array can radiate well in the broadside direction in the two operating bands with a miniaturized size.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of the First-order Characteristics of Two-level Priority Polling System Based on Parallel Gated and Exhaustive Services Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to ensure high quality network service requirements and user experience effects under the condition of limited network bandwidth resources, based on the priority polling architecture and parallel scheduling, this paper proposed a new system of two-class priority polling based on parallel optimization gated and exhaustive service mode. The system optimizes the service process and the conversion query process in parallel, which changes the pipeline operation mode of the traditional polling system and improves the overall efficiency of the polling system. The queuing system and mathematical analysis model are constructed according to queuing theory and stochastic process. After the derivation process of the first-order derivation, some complete expressions of the first-order characteristics are obtained, such as the mean queue length and mean cyclic period. Furthermore, computer simulation experiments are carried out, and the experimental results show that they are consistent with the theoretical calculations. System performance analysis shows that the mean queue length and mean cyclic period of the system have been significantly improved, which can better adapt to the requirements of high-quality network services under limited service resources.

articleTitle: Broadband Phase Prediction of Electromagnetic Metamaterials Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an example of applying Deep neural network (DNN) technology to accurately predict the reflection unit of fragmented electromagnetic metamaterials. Firstly, the simulated fragment produced by CST is divided into 16×16 fragment units with a dual symmetry axis. Then, through the random generation of fragment patterns, a 2~12GHz broadband phase response is obtained as the training set and test set of DNN. To improve the training performance of DNN, phase continuity processing and random judder data expansion in terms of data preprocessing are proposed. Also, a combination of three kinds of loss functions and a two-round training mode of small batch size-large batch size is proposed to realize ideal network training performance. Finally, some sample prediction results are given, which shows that our network has good wideband phase prediction ability.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Sparse Circular-Arc Arrays with Wide Angle Scanning Based on Iterative Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An iterative convex optimization algorithm for wide scanning sparse conformal array synthesis is proposed. Combined with the compressed sensing (CS) theory, the proposed method is used to find the optimal element position for multiple scanning angle patterns by using cooperative synthesis strategy. The iterative algorithm first uses Euler’s calculation transformation to overcome the problem that the element pattern cannot be superimposed in a unified coordinate system due to the different distribution positions of the array elements. Secondly, the non-convex sparsity problem of circular-arc array with limited mainlobe width is transformed into a convex form with minimized l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> norm. Several numerical simulations are operated to validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Compact UWB Filtering Power Divider with Quasi-Chebyshev Equal-Ripple Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A compact power divider with ultra-wideband (UWB) quasi-Chebyshev filtering response is proposed in this paper. By employing slotted microstrip cross-junction and hybrid slotline/ microstrip resonator, a UWB passband and wide isolation can be realized simultaneously. A perfectly matching is obtained by analyzing the equivalent circuits of even/odd mode. Then, a quasi-Chebyshev filtering response is theoretically realized by using the modified 2-port transmission-line (TL) network with asymmetrical port impedances. To verify our new approach, a prototype UWB PD operating at 3.1-10.8GHz is designed, the fractional bandwidth of the proposed PD is 110% (-15 dB return loss). Simulated results show good agreement with theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluation of SiC-based MOSFET in Electronic Power Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The discovery of a new material is usually accompanied by breakthroughs and developments in many other fields. In order to quantitatively evaluate the improvement of electronic power technology by SiC, this paper selects the maximum working frequency as the physical quantity to evaluate the advanced degree of electronic power devices. Through theoretical analysis, an equation for estimating the maximum operating frequency of the circuit is derived. On the hardware platform, the validity of the formula is verified by the comparative experiments of control variables. At the end of the paper, the maximum working frequencies of SiC-based MOSFET and Si-based MOSFET are measured by experiments, and the improvement of electronic power technology by SiC is evaluated quantitatively.

articleTitle: Conformance Testing of Link 16 Message Standard based on ATC-Gen
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Message standard is the key factor of data link. It specifies the standardized message formats and rules for realizing tactical functions. The complexity of message standard including thousands of rules described in natural language which is prone to ambiguous interpretations poses great challenges in conformance testing. Modeling and simulation (M&S) has been a core technology for conformance testing of message standard. In this paper, Automated Test Case Generator (ATC-Gen) which is initiated by Joint Interoperability Test Command (JITC) for Link 16 testing is studied. It greatly increases the simulation-based testing capabilities and automation of the testing processes. We discuss the ATC-Gen methodology and show the experiment results based on modeling and simulation (M&S) framework and Discrete Event System (DEVS) model.

articleTitle: Transparent and Flexible Absorber with Dynamically Frequency Modulation Using Graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a transparent and flexible absorber using graphene is presented, in which the frequency of the resonant absorption can be modulated in Ku band. The proposed absorber contains a four-layer structure including the patterned graphene capacitor, the periodical striper layer, the polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) layer and a metallic wire grid ground. By tuning the bias voltage applying to the graphene capacitor, the resonance frequency can be dynamically and continuously shifted from 16.7GHz to 14.6GHz according to the experimental measurement. The optically transparent and structurally flexible characteristics provide more flexibility for applications in electromagnetic stealth and electromagnetic protection of transparent optical components.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Design of Antenna Based on Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of antenna design, various intelligent optimization algorithms are used for settling the complex nonlinear problems involved. The whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is one of the relatively novel and well-performing swarm intelligence optimization algorithms. In this article, an improved whale optimization algorithm (IWOA) is proposed in view of the shortcomings of WOA. First, the nonlinear control parameter, adaptive weight and Cauchy disturbance are introduced to improve algorithm performance. Then a CEC benchmark function set is selected to test the feasibility and effectiveness of IWOA. The results show that IWOA has obvious advantages in terms of convergence speed, convergence accuracy and stability. Finally, the algorithm is used for the optimization of structural parameters of two ultra-wideband (UWB) antennas. The automated design of antenna is realized by MATLAB and HFSS joint simulation.

articleTitle: Antenna Topology Optimization Using BMOGWO Based on Competition and Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new efficient optimization method, called binary multi-objective grey wolf optimizer based on competition and teaching (BMOGWO-CT) mechanisms, is proposed for antenna topology optimization. This method reduces the calculation cost by reducing the number of calls to electromagnetic (EM) simulation software. Further, a design example of a compact ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna topology is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in saving computation time.

articleTitle: High Optical Transparent Wideband Microwave Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: It is challenging to design a thin and optical transparent wideband microwave absorber. In this paper, the optical transmittance of the proposed absorber is effectively improved, maintaining the wideband absorption. The method of improving optical transmission is discovered, through the analysis of the absorption mechanism and the transmittance of the proposed absorber. With the 82.1% high visible light transmittance, the proposed absorber can achieve around 90% absorption in 19.2–36GHz. The thickness is only 0.07λ at the lowest operating frequency, which is close to Rozanov’s ultimate thickness. The high transparency, wideband absorption, low thickness indicate that the proposed design has the potential for a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Pattern and Polarization Diversity Antenna for Indoor Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A pattern and polarization diversity antenna is presented. The antenna consists of two vertically oriented antennas. The lower antenna is a vertically polarized monocone antenna. And the upper antenna is a horizontally ±45° polarized microstrip antenna. The lower antenna is loaded with a cup-shaped patch to broaden the impedance bandwidth further and to improve the isolation between the two antennas. The microstrip antenna consists of a parasitic patch and a bottom patch with a coupling structure. The microstrip antenna is fed by two broadband out-of-phase power divider using dual-feed technique. The two antennas reuse part of their structure while remaining very small impact between the two antennas. The reusing technique makes the antenna more compact and reduces the effect of the coaxial cables. An antenna prototype is fabricated and measured. The lower antenna has a bandwidth of 117%. The upper antenna has a bandwidth of 46.5%, which is broader than most of the dual-polarize microstrip antenna. The isolation between any two of the three ports of the proposed antenna is better than 20dB. The lower antenna has a conical radiation pattern. The microstrip antenna has a broadside radiation pattern. Pattern and polarization diversity characteristics are obtained in the overlapping working band (1710MHz-2690MHz) simultaneously. The results show that the proposed design is suitable for indoor wireless communications.

articleTitle: A Multi-functional Ultra-thin Metasurface with Closely Separated Polarization-Conversion and Tunable-Absorption Band
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel multi-functional metasurface, owning to the capability of optional polarization conversion and tunable absorption, is presented. The working bands of these two kinds of performance are closely separated and can be adjusted independently. Moreover, the metasurface has only one substrate layer and very simple structure.

articleTitle: Multi-Band Resonant Metasurface and Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A multi-band metasurface has been proposed. Simulated and experimental absorption characteristics of the designed metasurface are studied. We demonstrate that the proposed metasurface can realize multi-band resonant absorption and high quality factor. The refractive index sensing performance of the metasurface is also investigated. The results show that the operating frequency of resonant absorption peaks shifts linearly with the refractive index of analytes increasing, which indicates that the designed multi-band metasurface can be applied for refractive index sensing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Broadband Satellite IF Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a broadband IF subsystem used in Ku-band satellite transceiver, and performs I/Q amplitude and phase imbalance calibration. This paper also designs a 16-channel microstrip Wilkinson power divider with a working frequency of 950-2150MHz. For the proposed transceiver, broadband image rejection tests are performed after I/Q imbalance calibration. The innovation of this paper is to use the adjustable gain module of amplification-attenuation-amplification to increase the dynamic range of the transceiver and avoid self-excitation caused by direct cascading of amplifiers. In addition, a high and low local oscillator switching filter is designed to filter out the second and above high-order harmonics to ensure the orthogonality of modulation and demodulation. The test results show that the proposed transceiver has good IRR and EVM performance, applicable for broadband satellite communication.

articleTitle: A Multi-layer Tunable Frequency Selective Surface with Highly Selective Response Based on Varactor Diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article presents a highly selective Tunable Frequency Selective Surface (TFSS) based on varactor diodes. The multi-layer structure generates multiple resonance frequencies and transmission poles to suppressing the passage of out-of-band electromagnetic waves. In addition, it is used to improve the roll-off characteristics of TFSS. The simulation results show that TFSS can be resistively tuned between 10.33 and 11.12 GHz with a insertion loss between 0.17 and 0.03dB. The select characteristic relative bandwidth of multi-layer TFSS is T1 = 5.2% and T2 = 4.97%. Compared with the single-layer FSS, the proposed TFSS is increased by 84.4% and 83.6%, which verified the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Super-directive Scattering of Optimized Multi-layered Dielectric Cylinder by Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Superdirective antenna can realize high channel capacity of multiple-input multiple-output system (MIMO). The optimization of superdirective scattering by a novel weighting optimizing goal and Dirac-Delta function model is proposed. Both main-lobe and side-lobe characteristics of the lobe are optimized. Compared with the traditional optimization method, which only takes the main-lobe characteristic into consideration, the directivity has improved by 50% (from 6.0 to 9.0).
