Meanwhile, the radius of the scattering object is only $0.1 \lambda_{0}$, which indicates this antenna is a super-directive antenna.

articleTitle: 325GHz Balanced Tripler Based On Schottky Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, based on the frequency multiplication link with Schottky diode as the core device, a zero-bias balanced 325GHz triple frequency multiplier is designed and simulated. In the alternate joint simulation of ADS and HFSS, the frequency doubling efficiency and working bandwidth required by the design goals are achieved. Finally, the design of a 325GHz zero-bias balanced five-frequency multiplier is realized. The simulation results show that when the input drive power is 78.9mW, the working condition of the quintuple is the best. The output power is greater than 1mW in the 330GHz-350GHz frequency band, and the output power is greater than 1mW in the 320GHz-330GHz frequency band, the best frequency multiplication efficiency is 7.416%, and the best output power is 5.9mW.

articleTitle: Dual Polarization Common Aperture Transceiver Antenna with High Radiation Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a kind of common aperture antenna which receiving antenna and transmitting antenna share the same aperture with each other. Specifically, the external antennas as receivers are composed of two pairs of dipoles in 1.73-1.79GHz and 1.91-1.97GHz, which excites 0° and 90° polarization, respectively; while the inner antenna as transmitter is a differential fed dielectric resonant antenna in 1.83-1.88GHz and 2.11-2.16GHz, which can excite ± 45 degree polarization. In this case, the external antenna has a stable gain of 10dB, and its XPD is greater than 26dB at 0° and 14dB at 60°; The internal antenna has a stable gain of 7. 9dB, and its XPD is greater than 37dB at 0° and 30dB at 60°; Besides, both internal and external antennas have 3dB beamwidth of 74° approximately. Especially, there is high port isolation between internal and external antennas. Thus, the design, which has stable radiation and port characteristics, can be applied for base station and array integration.

articleTitle: Fast Filling Algorithm of EDM-RACA Matrix Based on Centroid Segmentation Moment Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new method is proposed to solve the problem of accelerating matrix filling. Based on the centroid splitting method, the equivalent dipole moment (EDM) is used for matrix simultaneous filling, and the result has no singularity problem. On this basis, the recompression adaptive cross algorithm (RACA) is used to further compress the matrix. The final result shows that this method has high accuracy and can effectively reduce the calculation time and memory.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband Omnidirectional diople Antenna for Borehole Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband dipole antenna for borehole radar system is designed. By loading resistor and ferrite on the two arms of the dipole antenna to attenuate the current and expand the operation bandwidth, the bandwidth of 221-700MHz is achieved, and the relative bandwidth of the antenna is 104%. The time domain radiation waveform shows that the antenna has high peak-to-peak value of radiation signal and short tailing duration. Therefore, the antenna is suitable for borehole radar applications.

articleTitle: Compact and Dual-Band Antenna for Smartwatch Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a compact antennas is designd for smartwatch application, which covers both the LTE700/GSM850/GSM900 band and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth band. The antenna is inspired by the SRR structure, and it is composed of an inner loop and an outer loop, with capacitive structures built for impedance matching. When placed on a wrist, the antenna covers a relative bandwidth of 39.95% and 21.08%, respectively, for the center frequency of 850 MHz and 2.4 GHz. The peak SAR in the tissue is below the limitation when the antenna is placed on the wrist. The proposed antenna can support independence cellular communictions and is suitable for smartwatch.

articleTitle: A Polarization-Insensitive Coding Metasurface with Wideband RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A 1-bit coding metasurface composed of two Minkowski loops as coding elements with wideband and polarization-insensitive characteristics is presented in this paper. The 1-bit coding elements structure is composed of a dielectric layer, a Minkowski loop metallic layer and a metallic back ground layer, which conforms the same amplitude and 180°±37° phase difference. An annealing algorithm is employed to find the optimal sequence of coding elements for optimal RCS reduction. The simulation results show that the 1-bit coding metasurface enables a 10dB RCS reduction from 10.2GHz to 29.1GHz with polarization-insensitive property.

articleTitle: An Novel Ultra-Wideband Plane Wave Generator Antenna Array for OTA Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an ultra-wideband one-dimension plane wave generator (PWG) antenna array. Ten electrical small wideband Vivaldi antenna elements are employed. Both the coupling and environment effect are involved in the proposed plane wave excitations optimization method. The theoretical bandwidth covers over 0.7GHz to 7GHz. The PWG generates plane wave whose amplitude variation is below ±1.45dB and phase variation is below ±10.5° in work frequency band by proposed method, which is better than the traditional optimization method results.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Mission-Driven Networking Technologies in Data Link
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: At the end of the battlefield, the efficient networking among combat resources to ensure the real-time and reliable transmission of information is one of the keys to forming information superiority. Network resources will become scarcer in contested environments. According to the mission characteristics and differentiated needs, making full use of the limited network resource to guarantee task is the focus of network attention. Therefore how to optimize the use of limited network resources based on the characteristics of tasks becomes a very important issue. According to the research results in tactical data link and civil mobile communication many researchers have contributed, we compare the representative mission-driven networking technologies and analyze their integral development.

articleTitle: Additively Manufactured All-Dielectric Mm-Wave Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an additive manufactured dielectric reflectarray antenna for mm-wave communication applications. A dielectric mirror structure is used to reflects the EM-wave instead of conventional metal ground. Meanwhile, the dielectric mirror is properly arranged in the vertical direction to form the reflectarray. Thus, the air layer is used as the phase tuning to achieve stable and broadband radiation. A circularly polarized feed horn is used to illuminate and test the performance of the proposed dielectric reflectarray.

articleTitle: Random Forest Assisted RF Fingerprinting Positioning for Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Contextualization is a core of 6th Generation Mobile Communication Technology (6G), and communication perception has gradually become one of the critical business application scenarios. Therefore, it becomes particularly important to refine the classification of various intelligent scenarios and provide personalized services for mobile users. However, the constantly changing of scenarios is still a challenge for current network operators, which indicates that accurately identify and predict user location is the key to location-based services (LBS). In this paper, a random forest assisted radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting positioning method based on cellular big data is proposed to eliminate the interference of indoor fingerprints with incorrect GPS information on outdoor positioning. Firstly, we collect a large number of measurement reports (MRs) by minimized drive test (MDT) from typical urban areas covered by the present 4G Long Term Evolution (LTE) cellular network. Then, Indoor-Outdoor (IO) classification is realized using random forest after conducting feature engineering. Finally, RF fingerprinting positioning is performed on the basis of classification, and it can be found that the positioning error of the outdoor MRs based on purification was effectively reduced compared to the initial data. Specifically, when the probability is 67%, the positioning error after IO classification is about 5% lower than the original base.

articleTitle: Circular Polarization and Wideband Filtering Function Switching Device based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article proposes a switchable metasurface with dual functions of circular polarization and filtering. The device unit structure consists of two layers of dielectric substrates, three layers of metal surface and two PIN diodes. The simulation results show that by simultaneously controlling the ON and OFF states of the top and bottom PIN diodes, the metasurface device can achieve dual-function switching. When the two PIN diodes are OFF, the metasurface can realize wideband filtering. When the PIN diodes are turned ON at the same time, the metasurface has a line-to-circular polarization conversion function.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual Polarized Rectenna For Ambient RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel dual polarized rectenna for collecting RF energy is proposed. With the development of communication industry, more and more miniaturized devices need continuous and stable power supply. Considering the distribution of radio frequency (RF) energy in the environment, collecting RF energy in the environment for power supply of miniaturized devices has become the research focus. In this paper, a 2.45GHz rectifying antenna based on dual polarized antenna and single voltage rectifier circuit is proposed, which has high conversion efficiency. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulation results. It can be used for energy collection in low power density environment.

articleTitle: Research on Accuracy of River Velocity Measurement based on EM Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper established a river flow velocity measurement model in the clutter background of microwave scattering signals generated by Pierson-Moscowitz spectrum. First, the cloud data of the river are generated based on the random wave model and an electromagnetic calculation model is established. Second, the echo signal of the river is obtained based on the fullwave computational electromagnetic algorithm. Finally, the doppler frequency shift of the echo signal is calculated to deduce the river flow speed. Simulation result show that the proposed river velocity microwave measurement model is valid which has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Waveguide to Suspended Substrate Microstrip Line Transition Based on Quartz Substrate at 330GHz
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The waveguide-suspension microstrip line transition structure is an important component that can connect millimeter waves and terahertz waves. It is often used in the input and output parts of solid-state frequency multipliers and mixers that generate terahertz waves. This structure has a great impact on the performance of the system. This article designs several rectangular waveguide-suspension microstrip transition structures with a center frequency of 330GHz. The probe transition form is adopted in the transition structure. The feature of this article is to design and simulate different types of probe structures, and to reduce the loss as much as possible on the basis of ensuring a wider output frequency band. Finally, in the passband 310-350GHz frequency band, the return loss is better than 20dB; the insertion loss is less than 0.1dB.

articleTitle: APE-GAN: A Novel Active Learning Based Music Generation Model With Pre-Embedding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Being able to generate realistic musics is one of the biggest challenges for Artificial Intelligence, and the current models do not have musical descriptive ability as humans have and the musics they produce are not highly realistic. This paper proposed an active learning based music generation model with pre-embedding (APE-GAN) that can use textual inputs to generate musics, and have increased performance by active learning and a checking mechanism with the discriminator in GAN model. Through experiments, this work shows that APE-GAN only needs 5% to 10% humans labelled data to achieve relatively good music generation ability. This method uses BERT to obtain embedding vector, thus provides prior and artistic thoughts from humans so that our model can achieve a higher level of creativity than most of the popular methods. Finally, it would be too subjective to discriminate by humans whether a music sequence generated is “good” or not. This paper used an evaluation metric (Kullback–Leibler divergence, or KL divergence) based on similarity of music sequences generated by similar or different meanings textual inputs. After using Lakh Pianoroll Dataset to train APE-GAN, the similar meaning textual inputs result in outputs with KL divergence approximate to 0, while different meaning textual inputs result in outputs with KL divergence approximate to 1.

articleTitle: A Dual-band PIFA Design Based on CMA for ISM Band Wearable Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band wearable planar inverted - F antenna (PIFA) based on characteristic mode analysis (CMA) theory is proposed. The antenna can cover 0.43 GHz and 2.45 GHz Industrial Scientific Medical (ISM) bands. A slot and a defect structure are cut to adjust the resonances of the radiator. By adjusting the model significance (MS) values of the characteristic modes, the antenna can be optimized to achieve a good radiation performance without considering the feeding structure. The final antenna has a dimension with $0.18 \times 0.11 \times 0.008 \lambda^{3}$ (at 0.43 GHz), and the impedance matching band ranges from 0.417 GHz to 0.443 GHz, and from 2.20 GHz and 2.85 GHz. The maximum gain is -3 dBi and 4.3 dBi in the lower and upper bands, respectively. Meanwhile, Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) is evaluated in simulation, and the values are far lower than the recommended standards by FCC. Eventually, the prototype is fabricated and measured. The test results have the reasonable agreement with the simulation ones. The proposed antenna is an applicable candidate for wearable communication systems.
